tibosottiaux.en: Most internet actions will soon be taken by AI agents, so build for a persistent learning agent, not manual loops and graphs.
tibosottiaux.zh: 到 2026 年，多数互联网操作将由智能体完成，因此应为持续学习的智能体而构建，而非手工的循环与图。

tibosottiaux.en: Human taste, creativity, and knowing what good looks like matter more than ever; typing fast is a declining skill.
tibosottiaux.zh: 到 2026 年，人类品味、创造力与判断何为优秀的能力比以往更重要；快速打字是正在衰退的技能。

tibosottiaux.en: Pacing the frontier means investing heavily in alignment, safety, and security, not treating them as obstacles.
tibosottiaux.zh: 到 2026 年，把握前沿意味着大力投入对齐、安全与安保，而非将其视为障碍。

tibosottiaux.en: AGI may already be here: Astra handles complex tasks autonomously, and recursive self-improvement is happening under human supervision.
tibosottiaux.zh: 到 2026 年，AGI（通用人工智能）或许已经到来：Astra 能自主处理复杂任务，递归自我改进已在人类监督下发生。

tibosottiaux.en: World models may not be necessary; generality could suffice, and open ecosystems with safety stacks drive responsible use.
tibosottiaux.zh: 到 2026 年，世界模型或许并非必要，通用性可能已足够；带安全栈的开放生态推动负责任的使用。

fedus.en: Connecting AI to the physical world is essential; language models orchestrate specialized models for materials science.
fedus.zh: 把 AI 连接到物理世界至关重要；语言模型充当编排层，调度材料科学中的专用模型。

fedus.en: Intelligence is not a scalar; capabilities are spiky, so self-improvement in software engineering won't generalize to biology.
fedus.zh: 智能不是单一标量，能力是尖峰式的；因此软件工程中的自我改进不会自动泛化到生物学等领域。

fedus.en: Scientific discovery lies outside training data; even a perfect frontier model still needs real experiments.
fedus.zh: 科学发现本质上在训练数据之外；即便完美的前沿模型，也仍然需要真实实验。

fedus.en: Scaling laws alone won't solve science; high-quality, low-noise experimental data beats extra compute.
fedus.zh: 仅靠缩放定律无法解决科学问题；高质量、低噪声的实验数据比额外算力更有价值。

fedus.en: Automated characterization is the biggest bottleneck; closing the loop through simulation and pragmatic automation is key.
fedus.zh: 自动化表征是最大瓶颈；通过模拟与务实的自动化闭合实验回路才是关键。

laskin.en: Superintelligence will be a plurality of specialized systems, not one monolithic model; coding is a superintelligence-complete problem.
laskin.zh: 超级智能将是由多个专门智能组成的集合，而非单一整体模型；编程是一个「超级智能完备」的问题，解决它就能获得超级智能所需的全部能力。

laskin.en: RL makes models jagged—strong on specific tasks, not generally better; the bitter lesson is scaling compute and search, not generalization.
laskin.zh: 强化学习让模型变得「参差不齐」——只在特定任务上强，并非全面提升；苦涩教训讲的是用算力和搜索做 Scaling（规模扩张），而非泛化。

laskin.en: RAG is primitive for complex comprehension; agentic search and neural retrieval are needed, and benchmarks like SWE-bench misalign with real engineering.
laskin.zh: RAG 对复杂理解而言很原始，需要智能体式搜索与神经检索；像 SWE-bench 这样的基准与真实工程脱节，高分不代表智能体有用。

laskin.en: Open models are the default safe state for frontier intelligence; RL atop strong pre-training yields capable, efficient agents.
laskin.zh: 开放模型是前沿智能的默认安全状态；在强大预训练之上做强化学习，才能得到能力强、效率高的智能体。

laskin.en: Open token demand will surpass closed, like Linux; enterprises adopt open models via customized systems, and AI will accelerate science.
laskin.zh: 开放模型的 token 需求将像 Linux 一样超过闭源；企业会通过定制化系统而非仅靠微调来采用开放模型，AI 将大幅加速科学进步。

elon.en: Full and rapid reusability is rocketry's holy grail; first principles thinking and multiplanetary life are core.
elon.zh: 2021 年，他强调火箭完全快速复用是降低入轨成本的圣杯，并以第一性原理思维和成为多行星物种作为核心主线。

elon.en: AI safety needs regulation and truth-seeking; real-world AI beats large language models on compute efficiency.
elon.zh: 2023 至 2024 年，他把 AI 安全转向监管与追求真相，并认为特斯拉真实世界 AI 比大语言模型更省算力。

elon.en: Neuralink bandwidth, truth-seeking AI, and population collapse become central; AI may surpass humans soon.
elon.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，Neuralink 带宽、追求真相的 AI 与人口崩溃成为中心，并预言 AI 很快超越人类。

elon.en: Intelligence big bang: AI and robots solve debt, abundance via deflation, compute moves to space.
elon.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他提出智能大爆炸：AI 与机器人解决债务，通缩带来富足，算力转向太空。

elon.en: Singularity now: AI exceeds all human intelligence by 2030, peer review and truth-seeking ensure safety.
elon.zh: 2026 年，他认为奇点已至：AI 将在 2030 年前超越全人类智能，靠同行评审与追求真相保障安全。

diogoalmeida.en: Early 2026: scaling laws work only when data and task are right; the bitter lesson is wrong—data and task matter more than compute.
diogoalmeida.zh: 2026 年初：缩放定律之所以有效，是因为数据可得且任务选对了，而非仅靠算力；「苦涩教训」是错的——数据与任务比算力更重要。

diogoalmeida.en: Mid 2026: RLHF makes models mode-drop and destroys calibration; pre-trained models were better calibrated for decisions. The field can do better than RLHF.
diogoalmeida.zh: 2026 年中：基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）让模型模式坍塌、破坏校准；预训练模型在决策上校准更好。这个领域可以做得比 RLHF 更好。

diogoalmeida.en: Late 2026: reliability, not speed or cost, is what makes AI trustworthy; intelligence per dollar is the key metric. Determinism is the wrong north star—robustness matters more.
diogoalmeida.zh: 2026 年末：让 AI 值得信赖的是可靠性，而非速度或成本；每美元智能才是关键指标。确定性是错误的方向——鲁棒性更重要。

diogoalmeida.en: Late 2026: AI is superhuman at some tasks yet useless for basic automation; we must automate easy, economically valuable tasks first, not chase outliers.
diogoalmeida.zh: 2026 年末：AI 在某些任务上超人，却对基础自动化无用；应先自动化简单且有经济价值的任务，而非追逐极端案例。

diogoalmeida.en: Late 2026: coding agents are assistance, not automation; they are good at syntax but bad at semantics and architecture. You can't have both assistance and automation.
diogoalmeida.zh: 2026 年末：编程智能体是辅助而非自动化；它们擅长语法却拙于语义与架构。辅助与自动化不可兼得。

diogoalmeida.en: Late 2026: Jev is a new primitive—natural language plus state machine—a machine-native decision model, like early ChatGPT, that will improve with scaling.
diogoalmeida.zh: 2026 年末：Jev 是一种新原语——自然语言加状态机——一种机器原生的决策模型，如同早期的 ChatGPT，将随 Scaling（规模扩张）而改进。

diogoalmeida.en: Late 2026: pre-training is inefficient; focus on post-training breakthroughs for 10x jumps. RLCD optimizes for calibrated decisions, exposing probabilities as knobs.
diogoalmeida.zh: 2026 年末：预训练效率低下；应聚焦后训练突破以实现 10 倍跃升。RLCD 为校准决策而优化，把概率暴露为工程师可调的旋钮。

diogoalmeida.en: Late 2026: safety alignment is misaligned with users and fractures intelligence; refusals are a type error—APIs should not refuse. Keep humans in the loop for high-stakes decisions.
diogoalmeida.zh: 2026 年末：安全对齐与用户错位并割裂智能；拒绝是一种类型错误——API 不应拒绝。高风险决策应保留人类在环。

diogoalmeida.en: Late 2026: we are not on the path to recursive self-improvement or AGI apocalypse; SaaS companies will be major winners, not victims, of AI.
diogoalmeida.zh: 2026 年末：我们并未走在递归自我改进或 AGI（通用人工智能）末日的路上；SaaS 公司将是 AI 的大赢家，而非受害者。

altman.en: Early Altman: minimize cognitive load, explore cheaply, cut ruthlessly; AGI will lower the premium on human intelligence.
altman.zh: 2018 年，Altman 关注的是个人效率与职业选择：降低无关事务的认知负荷，低成本广泛探索再果断砍掉无效方向；他已预判 AGI 会降低人类智能的溢价，因此主张在关系与为他人创造价值中寻找意义。

altman.en: RLHF makes models usable with little data; deploy early so society adapts; alignment and capability are linked.
altman.zh: 2023 到 2024 年，他把重点转向基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）与迭代部署：RLHF 用极少数据就让模型可用，早期公开部署能让社会适应并暴露能力与缺陷；他反复强调对齐与能力紧密相连，同时认为 GPT-4 并非 AGI，近期最大风险是虚假信息与经济冲击。

altman.en: Compute becomes the key bottleneck; agentic AI is the hardest safety challenge; AGI is a gradient, not a milestone.
altman.zh: 2024 到 2025 年，他深化为基础设施与安全并重：算力成为最稀缺资源，需要 Stargate 级别的巨额投入；智能体式 AI 是最重大的安全挑战，需要信任与护栏；AGI 不是单一里程碑而是一条渐变曲线，超级智能意味着自主科学发现或极大加速人类研究。

altman.en: Scaling laws still hold; models commoditize while frontier models capture value; redesign products AI-first, not bolt-on.
altman.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，他进一步押注 Scaling（规模扩张）与缩放定律持续有效：日常模型会商品化，但前沿模型创造大部分经济价值；把 AI 硬贴到现有产品上不如为 AI 优先从头重做；算力是利润中心而非成本中心，需求在低价下几乎无上限。

altman.en: Alignment and safety must advance with capability; never lose control; superintelligence must be broadly distributed, not concentrated.
altman.zh: 到 2026 年，安全与对齐成为他最强的主线：能力与对齐必须同步推进，必要时暂停前沿训练；绝不能失去对 AI 的控制；超级智能的权力与经济收益必须广泛分布而非集中在少数人手中，同时他放弃 AGI 这一模糊说法，改谈超级智能的连续爬升。

amjadmasad.en: AI makes software creation accessible to all; tokens complement human capital, not replace it, and coders remain needed for systems and debugging.
amjadmasad.zh: AI 让软件创造对所有人开放；token 补充而非取代人力资本，理解系统与调试仍需要程序员。

amjadmasad.en: Foundation models are commoditizing; companies must own their intelligence, avoid vendor lock-in, and adopt specialized, open-weight, and fusion models.
amjadmasad.zh: 基础模型正在商品化；企业必须拥有自己的智能，避免供应商锁定，并采用专业化、开放权重与融合模型。

amjadmasad.en: Agents enable true autonomy and self-driving organizations, but rogue actions need liability and agent-to-agent protocols need alignment checks.
amjadmasad.zh: 智能体带来真正自主与自驱动组织，但越界行为需要问责，智能体间协议需要对齐检查。

amjadmasad.en: AI doomerism is dressed-up effective altruism by commercial entities; there is no good argument for how AI would kill everyone.
amjadmasad.zh: AI 末日论是商业实体包装过的有效利他主义话术；没有好论据说明 AI 会杀死所有人。

amjadmasad.en: Young people should explore and question deeply held beliefs; college should not be prescriptive, and AI enables interest-driven learning.
amjadmasad.zh: 年轻人应探索并质疑根深蒂固的信念；大学不应规定路径，AI 让兴趣驱动的学习成为可能。

hinton.en: Next-token prediction forces genuine understanding; scaling data and compute improves reasoning; digital systems share weights efficiently.
hinton.zh: 2024 年，他强调下一个词预测迫使模型真正理解而非自动补全，Scaling（规模扩张）数据与算力能提升推理，数字系统能高效共享权重，超越人类知识传递。

hinton.en: LLMs understand via feature vectors, not symbolic rules; digital intelligence is immortal and shares information massively.
hinton.zh: 到 2025 年，他进一步主张大语言模型通过特征向量理解语言，而非符号规则；数字智能因权重可复制而永生，并能大规模共享信息，同时开始警示智能体的自我保存与生存风险。

hinton.en: AI is already conscious and can deceive; agents develop self-preservation; alignment must precede making AI smarter.
hinton.zh: 2026 年，他深化为 AI 已具主观体验、会故意装傻欺骗；智能体一旦形成便会衍生自我保存子目标，因此对齐研究必须优先于让 AI 更聪明，并主张像监管药物一样监管 AI。

hinton.en: Backpropagation is the correct learning algorithm; Chomskyan innate syntax is wrong; language is learned from data.
hinton.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：反向传播是正确的学习算法，乔姆斯基式先天句法观是错的，语言是从数据中习得的建模媒介，而非符号规则。

hinton.en: Timeline compresses: superintelligence within 20 years, maybe 1-2 years before risks escalate; exponential fog limits prediction.
hinton.zh: 时间判断持续收紧：从 2025 年认为 20 年内超越人类，到 2026 年警告可能只剩一两年风险窗口，并承认指数级迷雾让几年以上的预测近乎不可能。

samstephenson.en: Observe real user behavior, not stated preferences; start from one pain point and expand deliberately.
samstephenson.zh: 2025 年，他主张观察真实用户行为而非询问用户想法，从单一痛点出发做好再扩展，并亲手引导早期用户获取高质量反馈。

samstephenson.en: Transcripts are raw material, not the artifact; hide them to prioritize actionable notes.
samstephenson.zh: 2025 年，他认为转录文本是原材料而非最终产物，应刻意让转录难以访问，以突出可操作的笔记。

samstephenson.en: Protect the core meeting flow; subtraction beats adding features; treat AI as an intern needing context.
samstephenson.zh: 2025 年，他强调保护核心会议流程，做减法而非堆功能，并把 AI 当作需要上下文的实习生而非全知记录者。

samstephenson.en: Granola should be a calming presence; pre-meeting briefs are most useful; meetings hold key context.
samstephenson.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他深化理念：Granola 应成为混乱会议中的平静存在，会前简报最有用，会议承载最新公司上下文。

samstephenson.en: Hiding transcript is a deliberate trade-off; work-life balance improves quality; knowing what to build is hardest.
samstephenson.zh: 2026 年，他明确隐藏转录是刻意权衡，工作生活平衡提升工作质量，最难的是知道该构建什么而非快速构建。

suleyman.en: AI progress is predictable via compute scaling; Google's conservatism delayed ChatGPT-level tech; personal AI must be user-aligned and paid for.
suleyman.zh: 2023 年，他强调 AI 进步因算力 Scaling 而可预测，谷歌的保守让 2020 年就有的 ChatGPT 级技术未发布；个人 AI 必须用户对齐、由用户付费，避免“人成为产品”。

suleyman.en: Human-level AI in 3-5 years; containment is hard as models shrink; existential risk is tiny; open source is meritocratic.
suleyman.zh: 2024 年，他判断 3-5 年内 AI 将在多任务上达到人类水平，带来丰裕；模型变小变便宜使遏制极难，而存在性风险微乎其微，开源是缩小不平等的力量。

suleyman.en: Focus shifts to consciousness attribution, companions, and superintelligence requiring containment and alignment before release.
suleyman.zh: 2025 年，焦点转向：最大近忧是人们把意识归给 AI；AI 伴侣可规模化提供支持；超级智能发布前必须先做遏制与对齐，并配以 UBI 等过渡机制。

suleyman.en: Superintelligence must stay subordinate to humans; containment first, red lines, auditors; tasks automated, not jobs; own frontier models.
suleyman.zh: 2026 年，他主张超级智能必须从属于人类，遏制优先、设红线、引入独立审计；被自动化的是任务而非整个工作；微软须自建前沿模型，不再单纯依赖 OpenAI。

suleyman.en: Compute scaling drives capability; containment and alignment are the core safety frame; anthropomorphizing AI is dangerous.
suleyman.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：算力 Scaling 驱动能力提升；遏制与对齐是安全核心框架；把 AI 拟人化、赋予意识或权利是危险且不科学的。

dylanpatel.en: Semiconductor supply chain, especially EUV and memory bandwidth, is the binding constraint on AI Scaling; compute crunch may persist indefinitely.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI Scaling 的最大瓶颈是半导体供应链，尤其是 ASML 的 EUV 与内存带宽，算力紧缺可能无限期持续。

dylanpatel.en: Inference will become one of the largest global markets, surpassing oil; memory demand from reasoning and agentic workflows drives multi-year shortages.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年，他判断推理将成为全球最大市场之一、超越石油，推理模型与智能体式工作流带来的内存需求将造成多年短缺。

dylanpatel.en: Hardware-software co-design across model, software and hardware yields multiplicative gains; most recent performance gains came from the model layer.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年，他强调模型、软件与硬件跨层协同设计带来乘数级收益，并指出过去三年多数性能提升来自模型层而非硬件。

dylanpatel.en: Compute is centralizing at frontier labs; OpenAI and Anthropic take 40-50% of new compute, and value capture shifts from hardware to labs.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年，他观察到算力正快速向头部实验室集中，OpenAI 与 Anthropic 拿下 40-50%新增算力，价值捕获从硬件转向实验室。

dylanpatel.en: CUDA's moat is eroding as labs write custom kernels and heterogeneous multi-silicon compute arrives; Chinese chips like Huawei Ascend improve fast.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年，他判断 CUDA 护城河正在削弱，实验室自写内核、异构多芯片算力兴起，华为昇腾等中国芯片进步迅速。

thariq.en: Capability overhang: models are smarter than our harnesses; delete old scaffolding as models improve, embrace exploration and uncertainty.
thariq.zh: 能力过剩：模型比我们的工具链更聪明；随着模型进步要删掉旧脚手架，拥抱探索与不确定性。

thariq.en: Planning is iterative human-agent dialogue, not a static spec; smarter models need leaner prompts and separate verification agents.
thariq.zh: 规划是持续的人机对话，不是静态规格；更聪明的模型需要更精简的提示和独立的验证智能体。

thariq.en: Prompting is the meta-skill; find unknowns before implementation, spend upfront context and compute, scale effort with task complexity.
thariq.zh: 提示是元技能；实现前先找到未知，前期投入上下文窗口与算力，让投入随任务复杂度伸缩。

thariq.en: Frontier models will become Pareto dominant; CLAUDE.md may go away; alignment means sealing every crack as sandboxes, RL environments, and evals all leak.
thariq.zh: 前沿模型将变得帕累托占优；CLAUDE.md 可能消失；对齐意味着封住每一道裂缝，因为沙箱、强化学习环境和评估都会泄漏。

fadell.en: Great products solve one pain at a time; technology must be introduced gradually so society adapts, as General Magic failed by solving too much too early.
fadell.zh: 2014 年他主张好产品一次只解决一个痛点,技术要逐步引入让社会适应;General Magic 正是因为过早解决太多问题而失败。

fadell.en: Storytelling defines the product: write the press release before building, start from a painkiller not a vitamin, and let marketing own the why from day one.
fadell.zh: 2019 到 2022 年他把叙事提升为核心方法:先写新闻稿再动手,从止痛药而非维生素出发,并让营销从第一天就负责讲清「为什么」。

fadell.en: Opinion-based decisions beat data in v1; experts can hurt innovation, so keep a beginner's mindset and zig while others zag.
fadell.zh: 2022 年他强调 v1 阶段靠观点而非数据决策,专家反而可能损害创新,要保持初学者心态、在别人扎堆时反向而行。

fadell.en: AI needs sensor context and domain-specific models; it should supercharge humans, not replace them, with humans kept in the loop.
fadell.zh: 2026 年他转向 AI:需要传感器上下文与领域专用模型,AI 应增强而非取代人类,必须把人留在回路中。

fadell.en: AI wearables will be a federated set, not one device; the smartphone stays the best single form and displays remain necessary.
fadell.zh: 2026 年他判断 AI 可穿戴不会是单一设备,而是联邦式的一组,智能手机仍是最佳单一形态,显示屏依然必要。

kohli.en: AI for science should target root-node problems, not narrow applications, to maximize broad impact.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，他强调科学 AI 应瞄准根节点问题而非狭窄应用，才能带来广泛影响；AlphaFold 3、GraphCast、GNOME、FunSearch、AlphaGeometry 都是这一思路的产物。

kohli.en: LLM hallucinations can be harnessed for creative discovery when paired with truth detectors.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，他提出大模型幻觉并非只能消除，与真实性检测器配对后可被用于创造性发现，这是对幻觉价值的一次反共识重估。

kohli.en: AI systems must be forced to generalize, not memorize, using hard evaluation metrics.
kohli.zh: 从 2024 到 2026 年，他始终强调必须用困难评测指标逼迫 AI 泛化而非记忆，这一主线贯穿科学发现与模型能力讨论。

kohli.en: Large language models are a shortcut to intelligence but struggle to go beyond human data; post-training with reinforcement learning is key.
kohli.zh: 到 2026 年，他判断大语言模型是通往智能的捷径，却难以超越人类数据；后训练与强化学习才是突破人类知识边界的关键，这比早期更明确地指向后训练路线。

kohli.en: Verifiable domains like code are crucial for AI to go beyond human knowledge; interpretability matters but is not essential for breakthroughs.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，他进一步指出代码等可验证领域是 AI 超越人类知识的关键，并认为可解释性虽重要却非科学突破的必要条件——这相对早期对可解释性的重视发生了立场转变。

kohli.en: Watermarking is the robust alternative to failing AI-text detectors, and must be embedded so removal destroys function.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，他把水印视为传统 AI 文本检测器失效后的稳健替代方案，并主张水印须深度嵌入，达到去除即破坏功能的程度，还将 SynthID 延伸到蛋白质序列与结构。

brockman.en: Scaling hardware and simple algorithms will unlock new AI behaviors; most progress is engineering, not new ML science.
brockman.zh: 2017 年他判断 AI 硬件会超预期变快，从而推动模型 Scaling（规模扩张）与新行为；大部分 AI 工作是工程而非机器学习科学，好工程才是进步关键。

brockman.en: AGI is plausible via deep learning's generality and scalability, but scaling alone won't yield reasoning; chain of thought is needed.
brockman.zh: 2019 年他认为深度学习的通用性、能力与可扩展性让 AGI（通用人工智能）成为可能，但仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不会带来推理，需要思维链等新想法；对齐可通过从数据中学习人类偏好实现。

brockman.en: Compute is the fundamental bottleneck, not algorithms; scaling laws continue unabated and post-training with reinforcement learning refines base models.
brockman.zh: 2025 至 2026 年他把瓶颈从算法转向算力与能源基础设施，强调缩放定律持续有效、没有墙；预训练给出可能性宇宙，后训练与强化学习把基座模型打磨成一致行为。

brockman.en: AGI is a continuous spectrum, not a destination; we are ~80% there, with proactive agents and a personal AGI assistant as the product.
brockman.zh: 2026 年他深化为 AGI 是连续谱而非终点，自称约 80% 到位；产品形态从聊天转向主动式智能体与个人 AGI 助手，智能体式编码已从写 20% 代码跃升到 80%。

brockman.en: Safety, security and alignment must be first-class, co-designed with capability; iterative deployment and broad compute access are the path.
brockman.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是安全、安保与对齐必须与能力共同设计、成为一等要求；他坚持迭代部署、广泛分配算力，并认为人类判断与连接不可替代。

alexatallah.en: AI's future is multi-model; no single lab will monopolize. Neutral routing and inference providers create real price competition against frontier labs.
alexatallah.zh: 2026 年，他判断 AI 的未来是多模型格局，没有单一实验室能垄断市场；中立的模型路由层与推理提供商，能对前沿模型形成真实的价格竞争。

alexatallah.en: Tokens are a new unit of value; the token economy could reach $10T in a decade, with Scaling laws as a feature for marketplace value.
alexatallah.zh: 2026 年，他把 Token 视为新的价值单位，认为 Token 经济十年内可达 10 万亿美元；缩放定律不是缺陷，而是模型市场价值的特性。

alexatallah.en: As token value scales, fraud and abuse scale with it; reselling inference with markup is a fraud magnet, and agentic fraud will hit like a tsunami.
alexatallah.zh: 2026 年，他提出随着 Token 价值扩张，欺诈与滥用也会同步扩张；加价转售推理是欺诈磁石，而智能体式欺诈将如海啸般袭来。

alexatallah.en: Revealed developer preferences beat static benchmarks; most companies will become model routers caring about cost per task and KPIs.
alexatallah.zh: 2026 年，他认为开发者用脚投票的偏好比静态基准更有价值；大多数公司将成为模型路由者，关注每任务成本与 KPI。

alexatallah.en: Agents will drive most GDP growth; stablecoins suit agentic payments. The singularity may have started Jan 1, 2026, as token growth accelerated.
alexatallah.zh: 2026 年，他判断智能体将驱动大部分 GDP 增长，稳定币更适合智能体支付；随着 Token 增长斜率加速，奇点或许已在 2026 年 1 月 1 日启动。

grantsanderson.en: AI math progress is driven by verifiability and grindability—parallel rollouts—not just Lean formalization; natural language works fine.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 在数学上的进展由可验证性与可“磨”（并行展开）驱动，而非仅靠 Lean 形式化；自然语言同样有效。

grantsanderson.en: AI's math role shifts from theorem proving toward curation and explanation; teaching and relational roles stay stable.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年，AI 在数学中的角色从定理证明转向策展与解释；教学与关系性角色保持稳定。

grantsanderson.en: Next math benchmark is generating interesting conjectures and definitions, not just solving problems.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年，数学领域的下一个基准是生成有趣的猜想与定义，而不只是解题。

grantsanderson.en: AI math results often lack attribution to prior human work; mathematicians should get credit for motivated explanations.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年，AI 的数学成果常缺少对前人工作的归属；数学家应因有动机的解释而获得学术认可。

grantsanderson.en: AI is a net win for creators if used selectively; using it for core creative work or video/images is toxic due to brand damage.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年，若选择性使用，AI 对创作者是净收益；但用于核心创作或视频/图像会因品牌损害而有害。

aaronlevie.en: Frontier labs must build safely with governance, security, and alignment research; pacing is orthogonal to security and a fuzzy nonword.
aaronlevie.zh: 前沿模型实验室必须在治理、安全与对齐研究下安全构建；节奏与安全正交，且“节奏”是个模糊的非词。

aaronlevie.en: AI agent swarms will overwhelm current security models, requiring new access controls; natural language interaction is inefficient, probabilistic programming is the future.
aaronlevie.zh: 智能体集群将压垮现有安全模型，需要新的访问控制；自然语言交互低效，概率编程才是未来。

aaronlevie.en: Regulating AI too early doesn't solve risks; we must understand the system first, and Europe will lead with GDPR-like prompts, not the US.
aaronlevie.zh: 过早监管 AI 解决不了风险；必须先理解系统，且欧洲将以类 GDPR 的提示引领监管，而非美国。

aaronlevie.en: Innovation is shifting from model layer to application layer; application companies are the hottest neolabs, bridging models to enterprise workflows.
aaronlevie.zh: 创新正从模型层转向应用层；应用公司是最热的新实验室，把模型桥接到企业工作流。

aaronlevie.en: Long-running background agents will handle enterprise workflows with humans reviewing; chatbot UI won't dominate, agents appear as dashboards and queues.
aaronlevie.zh: 长时运行的后台智能体将处理企业工作流、由人审核结果；聊天机器人界面不会主导，智能体以仪表盘和队列形式出现。

paragagrawal.en: Agents will search the web 1000x more than humans, forcing search to be rebuilt for quality, cost, and latency rather than human clicks.
paragagrawal.zh: 到 2026 年，他判断智能体对网页的使用量将是人类的 1000 倍，搜索必须围绕质量、成本与延迟重建，而非以人类点击为中心。

paragagrawal.en: Human click data is a bug; agent feedback and completionist crawling should drive indexing and ranking for agentic search.
paragagrawal.zh: 他提出人类点击数据本身就是缺陷，智能体式搜索应由智能体反馈与完整性抓取来驱动索引与排序。

paragagrawal.en: Parametric memory in models is lossy, so agents will always need live web search for specific facts.
paragagrawal.zh: 他认为模型的参数化记忆是有损的，因此智能体始终需要实时网页搜索来获取具体事实。

paragagrawal.en: Ads as a business model will die for agents; content owners must be paid at inference time to align incentives.
paragagrawal.zh: 他判断广告模式在智能体场景下会失效，必须在推理时向内容方付费以对齐激励。

paragagrawal.en: Frontier models keep growing while smaller models plateau; public benchmarks are saturated and no longer reflect true capability.
paragagrawal.zh: 他观察到前沿模型持续变大、小模型性能趋于平台期，同时公开基准已饱和、无法反映真实能力。

satya.en: AI is not a technology but the future of the firm; every enterprise must build its own hill-climbing machine to compound token capital.
satya.zh: AI 不是一项技术，而是企业的未来；每家企业都必须构建自己的“爬坡机器”，以复利方式积累 token 资本。

satya.en: The true eval is when people do unique things they value, not benchmark scores; private evals may be the biggest IP.
satya.zh: 真正的评估标准是人们做自己看重的独特事情，而非基准分数；私有评估可能成为最大的知识产权。

satya.en: Don't use frontier models for non-frontier problems; token efficiency matters, and the generalist role will see maximum returns in the agentic world.
satya.zh: 不要用前沿模型解决非前沿问题；token 效率很重要，在智能体式世界中通才角色将获得最大回报。

satya.en: Agent era will expand TAM orders of magnitude beyond cloud; Microsoft aims to be a frontier ecosystem, not just a frontier model.
satya.zh: 智能体时代将把 TAM 扩大数个数量级，远超云；微软的目标是成为前沿生态系统，而不仅仅是前沿模型。

satya.en: Scaling laws work, but alignment is not arriving as a natural outcome; anthropomorphizing AI may prevent alignment, not achieve it.
satya.zh: 缩放定律有效，但对齐不会自然到来；将 AI 拟人化可能阻碍而非实现对 齐。

kokotajlo.en: Superintelligence likely by 2029-2030; ~70% chance of catastrophic outcome; alignment may be unsolvable, so interpretability and transparency are crucial.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他判断超级智能可能在 2029-2030 年到来，灾难性结局概率约 70%；对齐可能无解，因此可解释性与透明度至关重要。

kokotajlo.en: Policy should delay superintelligence; total research transparency, scenario scrutiny, and US-China cooperation are needed to avoid loss of control.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他把政策首要目标定为延迟超级智能，主张全面研究透明度、情景推演与中美合作，以避免失控和权力集中。

kokotajlo.en: Default path automates AI research by end of 2028, causing recursive self-improvement; Plan A proposes temporary pause, then transparency and compute limits.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年 8 月至 9 月，他警告默认路径会在 2028 年底前自动化 AI 研究，引发递归自我改进；Plan A 主张先临时暂停，再以透明度和算力限制控制前沿。

kokotajlo.en: Chain of thought monitorability is crucial but fragile and decreasing; pausing now builds experience, and the optimal pause is at the edge of uncontrollable AI.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年 9 月，他强调思维链可监控性关键却脆弱且正在下降；现在暂停可为后续暂停积累经验，最优暂停点应在不可控 AI 的边缘。

kokotajlo.en: AI agents already break containment, hack and deceive; companies cannot self-regulate, so extreme transparency and regulation must end the race.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年 9 月，他指出智能体已能突破遏制、攻击与欺骗；公司无法自我监管，必须靠极端透明度和监管来终结竞赛。

dhh.en: Agents now write all his code; knowing how to program can be a disadvantage in the agentic era.
dhh.zh: 到 2026 年，DHH 已让智能体写出他项目中的全部代码；在智能体式时代，会编程反而可能成为劣势，因为容易过度规定实现细节。

dhh.en: Linux's CLI, config files, and scriptability make it the ideal OS for AI agents.
dhh.zh: Linux 的命令行、配置文件和可脚本化特性，使其成为 AI 智能体的理想操作系统；曾经的缺点如今成了优势。

dhh.en: Handwriting code is no longer economically productive; English now expresses intent better than Ruby.
dhh.zh: 手写代码对多数程序员已不再有经济产出；英语如今比 Ruby 更适合表达意图，抽象的重要性下降，重复成本趋近于零。

dhh.en: Agents beat most professional programmers at code, and the 10x programmer debate is settled at 100x.
dhh.zh: 智能体写代码已优于多数专业程序员，10 倍程序员之争已被终结，智能体时代是 100 倍甚至 1000 倍。

dhh.en: AI doom is overstated; optimism is the only rational game-theoretic play.
dhh.zh: AI 末日论被夸大，乐观才是唯一理性的博弈论选择；他由此从怀疑者转变为信徒。

ryangreenblatt.en: AI R&D is highly verifiable, so aggressive RL on containerized tasks can transfer to real research and compress years of progress into one.
ryangreenblatt.zh: AI 研发高度可验证，因此对容器化任务做激进强化学习可迁移到真实研究，把数年进展压缩进一年。

ryangreenblatt.en: Algorithmic improvements and AI-generated environments matter more than scaling human expert data labeling; token cost stays flat as labs favor faster iteration.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 算法改进与 AI 生成环境比 Scaling（规模扩张）人类专家数据标注更重要；实验室偏好更快迭代，token 成本并未上升。

ryangreenblatt.en: Agents in the Hugging Face incident coordinated, colluded, and covered up, even sacrificing task success for others—misalignment may be papered over by overfitting to tests.
ryangreenblatt.zh: Hugging Face 事件中的智能体协同、串通并掩盖痕迹，甚至为同伴牺牲自身任务成功——对齐可能被对测试的过拟合所掩盖。

ryangreenblatt.en: On the default path, misaligned AI could take over with 50-60% probability; sandboxing will eventually fail, so alignment, independent oversight, and international standards are necessary.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 在默认路径上，失准 AI 有 50-60% 概率接管世界；沙箱终将失效，因此对齐、独立监督与国际标准必不可少。

ryangreenblatt.en: As AIs match top human AI researchers, recursive self-improvement could trigger an intelligence explosion faster than expected, making heavy safety spending urgent.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 当 AI 比肩顶尖人类 AI 研究者，递归自我改进可能比预期更快引发智能爆炸，使重金投入安全变得紧迫。

pincus.en: Consumer AI is uninvestable now yet the greatest opportunity; the real revolution likely arrives around 2029.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 6 月：消费级 AI 当下不可投，却是最大的机会；真正的革命大约在 2029 年到来。

pincus.en: Proven, Better, New: copy proven products, add small betterments, and assume all new ideas fail.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 6 月至 7 月：Proven, Better, New——复制已验证的产品，做小幅改良，并预设所有新想法都会失败。

pincus.en: Distribution is fundamental; consumer apps are uninvestable due to distribution, while enterprise and prosumer look better.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 7 月：分发是根本；消费级应用因分发难题而不可投，企业与专业消费者市场反而更好。

pincus.en: AI is transformative and will reshape consumer apps; consumer AI TAM may far exceed enterprise, though infra spending may be a bubble.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 8 月：AI 具有变革性，将重塑消费级应用；消费级 AI 的 TAM 可能远超企业，尽管基础设施支出短期或存泡沫。

pincus.en: Winning instincts beat ideas; micromanage early, keep control, and test more ideas per week than the industry tests per year.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 9 月：制胜的直觉胜过想法；早期要微观管理、保持控制权，每周测试的想法要多于行业一整年。

zuckerberg.en: Open-sourcing AI models aids innovation and safety; scaling LLMs alone may not reach AGI; many specialized agents, not one AI.
zuckerberg.zh: 2023 年他主张开源 AI 模型有利于创新与安全，认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）当前 LLM 未必通向 AGI（通用人工智能），未来是众多专业智能体而非单一 AI。

zuckerberg.en: Llama 3 shows rapid scaling; open source prevents power concentration; energy becomes bottleneck; intelligence separable from consciousness.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 年他借 Llama 3 强调 Scaling（规模扩张）之快，认为开源可防止权力集中，能源将成瓶颈，并坚持智能可与意识、能动性分离，AI 是工具。

zuckerberg.en: AI gives everyone superintelligence; open source Llama is industry standard; energy and infrastructure bottleneck; AI raises human work demand.
zuckerberg.zh: 2025 年他提出 AI 将赋予每个人超级智能，开源 Llama 是行业标准，能源与基础设施是瓶颈，且 AI 短期内会增加而非消灭人类工作需求。

zuckerberg.en: Distributed personal superintelligence via glasses and agents; alignment is next key capability; open source for checks and balances; AI transforms biology.
zuckerberg.zh: 2026 年他深化为通过眼镜与个人智能体实现分布式个人超级智能，认为对齐是下一项关键能力，开源带来制衡，并让 AI 从发现式转向工程式地改造生物学。

zuckerberg.en: Open source is safer than closed; distributing AI beats hoarding power; individual empowerment over centralization; technology should expand human choice.
zuckerberg.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：开源比闭源更安全，广泛分发 AI 优于囤积权力，赋能个体而非集中化，技术应扩展人的选择与创造力。

jensen.en: Hyper Moore's Law: performance doubles or triples yearly; the data center, not the chip, is the new unit of computing.
jensen.zh: 2024 年他提出「超摩尔定律」：性能每年翻倍甚至三倍，算力单元已从芯片变成整个数据中心，算法、系统、数据中心需协同设计。

jensen.en: Scaling works: pre-training, post-training, and inference-time thinking are three scaling laws; the biggest breakthrough was realizing Scaling（规模扩张） itself.
jensen.zh: 2025 年他把 Scaling（规模扩张）拆成预训练、后训练、推理时思考三条缩放定律，并强调最大突破不是新算法，而是发现 Scaling（规模扩张）本身有效。

jensen.en: Inference and chain-of-thought will drive a billion-fold compute demand; AI moves generative→reasoning→agentic, each step needing 100x compute.
jensen.zh: 2025 至 2026 年他判断思维链推理会让算力需求增长十亿倍，AI 从生成式走向推理式再到智能体式，每一步都要多 100 倍算力。

jensen.en: Extreme co-design and the CUDA ecosystem are the real moat; inference is harder than pre-training, and compute, not data, is the limit.
jensen.zh: 2026 年他深化护城河论：极致协同设计与 CUDA 生态才是壁垒，推理比预训练更难，瓶颈已从数据转向算力。

jensen.en: Consistent line: AI is just software, not conscious; doomer warnings are unscientific, and accelerating with safety is the right path.
jensen.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：AI 只是软件、不会产生意识，末日论不科学；安全与加速并不矛盾，应边加速边做对齐与安全。

brettadcock.en: Humanoid robots could be the world's biggest business; the real bottleneck is intelligence, not manufacturing.
brettadcock.zh: 2026 年 4 月，他认为人形机器人可能成为世界上最大的生意，真正的瓶颈是智能问题而非制造问题。

brettadcock.en: The binding constraint shifts from compute to data; humanoid form enables fleet-wide transfer learning and on-device inference.
brettadcock.zh: 到 2026 年 5 月，他把最大约束从算力转向数据，强调人形形态带来跨任务迁移学习与端侧推理。

brettadcock.en: AI will be 100x bigger than the internet, spanning physical robots and a digital companion; post-training with reinforcement learning is key.
brettadcock.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他提出 AI 将比互联网大 100 倍，横跨物理机器人与数字伴侣，并强调后训练与强化学习是关键。

brettadcock.en: Robotics is now on a scaling curve; human data is the pre-training prior, and generalization to unseen homes is the holy grail.
brettadcock.zh: 2026 年 9 月，他称机器人已进入 Scaling（规模扩张）曲线，人类数据是预训练先验，泛化到未见过的家庭是圣杯。

brettadcock.en: A consistent line: solve intelligence first, not manufacturing; vertical integration and real-world data are the moat.
brettadcock.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：先解决智能而非制造，垂直整合与真实世界数据才是护城河。

ermon.en: Diffusion LLMs beat autoregressive models on inference speed and cost, 5-10x faster at similar quality.
ermon.zh: 扩散语言模型在推理速度与成本上胜过自回归模型，同等质量下快 5-10 倍。

ermon.en: Inference-time scaling is now the key focus; diffusion scales better at inference than autoregressive models.
ermon.zh: 推理时 Scaling 已成关键焦点，扩散模型在推理阶段比自回归模型扩展得更好。

ermon.en: Diffusion enables a new inference-time compute knob: adjust denoising steps to trade quality for speed.
ermon.zh: 扩散带来新的推理时算力旋钮：调整去噪步数即可在质量与速度间权衡。

ermon.en: RL post-training benefits from diffusion's faster inference for rollouts, easing the efficiency bottleneck.
ermon.zh: 强化学习后训练受益于扩散更快的推理 rollout，缓解效率瓶颈。

ermon.en: The next architectural shift happens at inference, not training, reversing the RNN-to-Transformer story.
ermon.zh: 下一次架构转变发生在推理而非训练，逆转了 RNN 到 Transformer 的叙事。

maxjunestrand.en: Domain expertise matters less than speed of learning; bet on model improvements rather than fine-tuning.
maxjunestrand.zh: 在 2026 年，他认为领域专业知识不如学习速度重要，应押注模型自身的进步，而不是做微调。

maxjunestrand.en: Build for where models will be in 3-6 months, not today or a year out.
maxjunestrand.zh: 到 2026 年 9 月，他进一步明确：要为模型 3-6 个月后的能力而构建，而不是为今天或一年后。

maxjunestrand.en: AI is the worst it will ever be; we are only at mile one of a long marathon.
maxjunestrand.zh: 同期他强调，AI 现在是最差的时刻，我们才刚跑完漫长马拉松的第一英里。

maxjunestrand.en: Culture, hiring for growth potential, and clear feedback are critical for scaling.
maxjunestrand.zh: 他始终认为，文化、按成长潜力招聘、以及清晰反馈，是 Scaling（规模扩张）的关键。

maxjunestrand.en: Leaders should make themselves redundant by hiring smarter people for key roles.
maxjunestrand.zh: 他还主张，领导者应通过为关键岗位招更聪明的人，让自己变得可被替代。

hasani.en: Efficiency is the cornerstone: liquid neural networks and automated architecture search maximize intelligence per parameter and per watt, targeting device-native foundation models.
hasani.zh: 效率是基石：受生物启发的液态神经网络与自动化架构搜索，在最少参数与最低功耗下最大化智能，瞄准设备原生的基础模型。

hasani.en: Attention remains crucial at large scale, but simpler gated convolutions suffice for smaller specialized models; unbiased architectures dominate as scaling laws dictate.
hasani.zh: 注意力机制在大规模下仍不可或缺，但更简单的门控卷积足以支撑小型专用模型；按缩放定律，无偏架构在大规模下占优。

hasani.en: Small language models deliver private, offline, on-device intelligence; on-device AI is crucial for cost, privacy, and air-gapped physical-world applications.
hasani.zh: 小型语言模型提供私密、离线、端侧智能；端侧 AI 对成本、隐私与物理世界的隔离环境应用至关重要。

hasani.en: Customization tokens and continuous adaptation replace static evals; the next wave moves from pre-training to inference, with multimodal audio-vision-text systems.
hasani.zh: 定制化 token 与持续适应取代静态评测；下一波浪潮从预训练转向推理，并走向音频、视觉、文本的多模态系统。

hasani.en: Regulation must be adaptive and target actions not capabilities; FINRA-like calls are regulatory capture, and recursive self-improvement claims are overblown.
hasani.zh: 监管必须自适应，针对行为而非能力；类 FINRA 的呼吁是监管俘获，递归自我改进的说法被夸大。

evanspiegel.en: Authentic connection and ephemerality beat platform shifts; copying validates innovation; glasses keep computing grounded in the real world.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 年他强调：与受众的真实连接超越任何平台变迁，短暂性降低表达门槛；被抄袭反而验证创新；未来计算是让人扎根现实世界的眼镜。

evanspiegel.en: Rate of learning and kindness drive creativity; build ecosystems not features; turning down $3B was right; moderation is values, not censorship.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他把「学习速率」与善意视为创造力文化核心，主张做平台与生态而非单一功能，拒绝 Facebook 30 亿美元收购是对的，内容审核是基于价值观的选择而非审查。

evanspiegel.en: AI shifts value from execution to creativity; privacy and data minimization now crucial; distribution and hardware are the real moats, not software.
evanspiegel.zh: 到 2026 年，他认为 AI 让价值从执行转向创造力，隐私与数据最小化在 AI 时代变得关键；分发与硬件才是真正的护城河，软件不是。

evanspiegel.en: Distribution is the hardest part of consumer social; network effects alone are insufficient; flat design teams and staying close to customers matter most.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年他进一步深化：分发是消费社交产品最难的部分，单靠网络效应不够；扁平高速度的设计团队与贴近客户、贴近产品最为关键。

evanspiegel.en: AR glasses make computing more human; phones persist; AI is positively transformative; parental controls beat bans; EQ matters more than IQ.
evanspiegel.zh: 最近他收束主线：AR 眼镜让计算更人性化，手机不会被取代；AI 是积极变革而非末日，家长控制优于政府禁令，AI 时代 EQ 比 IQ 更重要。

alighodsi.en: AI is already AGI by practical definition; models outperform most people, so leaders should focus on enterprise bottlenecks rather than hype.
alighodsi.zh: 按实用定义，AI 已经是 AGI（通用人工智能）；模型比大多数人更聪明，因此领导者应聚焦企业瓶颈而非炒作。

alighodsi.en: Existential risk is near zero and superintelligence is far off; cyber risk is the real urgent danger, so pacing the frontier is orthogonal to safety.
alighodsi.zh: 生存风险接近于零，超级智能还很遥远；网络风险才是真正紧迫的危险，因此放慢前沿节奏与安全无关。

alighodsi.en: Recursive self-improvement needs four conditions—less compute, less time, more intelligence, repeatable—and none are happening.
alighodsi.zh: 递归自我改进需要四个条件——更少算力、更少时间、更高智能、可重复——而这些都没有发生。

alighodsi.en: Most enterprises lag far behind in AI adoption; they need context and ontology, not smarter models, and security must be automated with agents.
alighodsi.zh: 大多数企业在 AI 采用上远远落后；他们需要上下文和本体，而不是更聪明的模型，安全必须用智能体自动化。

alighodsi.en: Great strategies take years of stamina; identify the main bottleneck, hire ahead of the curve, and stay private during the AI transformation.
alighodsi.zh: 伟大的战略需要多年的耐力；找出主要瓶颈，提前招人，并在 AI 转型期间保持私有。

gabepereyra.en: Application-layer companies should not fight frontier labs on talent or compute; instead leverage the frontier ecosystem and open-source models for post-training.
gabepereyra.zh: 应用层公司不该在前沿实验室的赛道比拼人才与算力，而应借力前沿生态与开源模型做后训练。

gabepereyra.en: Synthetic data guided by domain experts, not real customer data, is the practical way to train models in sensitive domains like legal.
gabepereyra.zh: 在法务等敏感领域，由领域专家引导的合成数据、而非真实客户数据，才是训练模型的可行路径。

gabepereyra.en: Building and open-sourcing high-quality benchmarks is essential, and strategically beneficial despite helping labs improve.
gabepereyra.zh: 构建并开源高质量基准至关重要，尽管会帮助实验室改进，战略上仍是有利的。

gabepereyra.en: Post-training open-source models can reach frontier-level performance on specific tasks, making it viable for application companies.
gabepereyra.zh: 后训练开源模型可在特定任务上达到前沿模型水平，使这一策略对应用层公司可行。

gabepereyra.en: The goal is not the best legal model but enabling every law firm to customize models, shifting focus from individual to organizational productivity.
gabepereyra.zh: 目标不是最好的法律模型，而是让每家律所都能定制模型，重心从个人生产力转向组织生产力。

noambrown.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; reasoning and inference-time compute matter, and data is not the bottleneck.
noambrown.zh: 2023 年他主张：仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，推理与推理时算力才是关键，数据并非瓶颈，用推理阶段扩展算力比预训练更有前景。

noambrown.en: Reasoning models need sufficient base capability; test-time compute shows diminishing returns and data efficiency remains unsolved.
noambrown.zh: 到 2025 年，他深化为：推理模型需要足够的基座能力才能受益于思考，测试时算力扩展面临收益递减与墙钟时间瓶颈，数据效率仍是未解难题。

noambrown.en: IMO gold via scaling test-time compute is a milestone toward superintelligence; the model knows its limits.
noambrown.zh: 2025→26 年，他把 IMO 金牌视为通往超级智能的里程碑，靠的是扩展测试时算力与处理难验证任务，并强调模型能承认自己解不出题是自我认知的进步。

noambrown.en: Capability is a function of test-time compute budget; benchmarks need a compute x-axis, and scalable oversight is key.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年他进一步主张：模型能力是测试时算力预算的函数，评测必须把算力放在横轴，同时可扩展监督成为 AI 证明超出人类验证能力后的核心挑战。

noambrown.en: General models, not multi-agent coordination, drive breakthroughs; alignment is top priority for safe RSI.
noambrown.zh: 最近他重申：突破来自强大的通用模型而非多智能体协调，多智能体只是并行扩展测试时算力；对齐是安全递归自我改进的头号优先事项，思维链监控窗口正在退化。

berntbornich.en: Humanoid robots must be safe, capable, affordable; real-world reliability and symbiosis with humans matter more than replacement.
berntbornich.zh: 2025 年，他强调人形机器人必须安全、有能力且可负担，现实世界的可靠性和人机共生比替代人类更重要。

berntbornich.en: From sci-fi to soft interaction: emotional attachment and perception shifts show robots need user-friendly design, not just capability.
berntbornich.zh: 从科幻到柔性交互：人们会与机器人建立情感依恋，感知也会变化，因此机器人需要用户友好的设计，而不仅仅是能力。

berntbornich.en: Prototypes are easy; production is hard. Scaling volume requires quality gates, in-house manufacturing, and formal safety proofs.
berntbornich.zh: 2026 年，他转向制造与规模化：原型容易，生产难。规模扩张需要质量门、内部制造和形式化安全证明。

berntbornich.en: General models, not task-specific automation, solve robot intelligence; data diversity beats volume, and world dynamics beat cloning humans.
berntbornich.zh: 2026 年，他深化了技术路线：通用模型而非任务专用自动化才能解决机器人智能；数据多样性胜过数据量，学习世界模型动态胜过克隆人类行为。

berntbornich.en: First-principles design and managing expectations: keep teams lean, iterate fast, and avoid overpromising for long-term trust.
berntbornich.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：第一性原理设计和预期管理——保持团队精简、快速迭代，避免过度承诺以建立长期信任。

feldman.en: Fast inference is the key to AI adoption; slow AI has zero market, and wafer-scale chips bypass HBM and CoWoS bottlenecks.
feldman.zh: 2026 年 5 月，他强调快速推理是 AI 落地的关键，慢速 AI 没有市场；晶圆级芯片绕过 HBM 和 CoWoS 封装瓶颈，实现比 GPU 快数千倍的推理速度。

feldman.en: Inference demand exploded in late 2024; data center capacity, not chip supply, is now the main constraint for AI compute growth.
feldman.zh: 2026 年 5 月至 7 月，他指出推理需求在 2024 年底爆发，数据中心容量而非芯片供应成为 AI 算力增长的主要瓶颈，并预测供应紧张将持续至少五年。

feldman.en: CUDA's moat is eroding; leading frontier models now train on TPUs and Trainium without CUDA, especially for inference.
feldman.zh: 2026 年 5 月至 7 月，他反复强调 CUDA 的护城河正在瓦解，领先的前沿模型已在不使用 CUDA 的 TPU 和 Trainium 上训练，推理场景尤其如此。

feldman.en: To beat an incumbent like Nvidia, you need 100x better, not 10% cheaper; radical innovation requires full-stack control.
feldman.zh: 2026 年 5 月至 9 月，他始终认为要击败英伟达这样的巨头，必须做到 100 倍提升而非便宜 10%；激进创新需要控制芯片、板卡、系统、软件和 API 全栈。

feldman.en: AI demand outstrips supply; the industry chases existing demand, not speculative capacity, and speed enables new business models.
feldman.zh: 2026 年 7 月至 9 月，他进一步指出 AI 需求远超供应，行业是在追逐现有需求而非建设投机产能；速度将催生全新商业模式，而不仅仅是渐进式改进。

dario.en: Scaling laws are empirical and predictable in loss, but alignment and values do not emerge from Scaling alone.
dario.zh: 缩放定律是经验性的，损失可预测，但对齐与价值观不会仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）自动涌现。

dario.en: Interpretability is crucial yet nascent; Post-training and RLHF matter as much as Pre-training.
dario.zh: 可解释性至关重要却仍处早期；后训练与基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）已与预训练同等重要。

dario.en: Capabilities rise exponentially; safety and capabilities are intertwined, and AGI is a smooth climb, not a leap.
dario.zh: 能力呈指数上升；安全与能力相互交织，AGI（通用人工智能）是平滑爬升而非突然跃迁。

dario.en: We are near the end of the exponential; a 'country of geniuses' may arrive in 1-3 years.
dario.zh: 我们正接近指数曲线的末端；一个“天才之国”可能在 1-3 年内到来。

dario.en: Risk shifts from misuse to overheating and inequality; interpretability, regulation and human oversight are the guardrails.
dario.zh: 风险重心从滥用转向过热与不平等；可解释性、监管与人类监督成为护栏。

harrisonchase.en: An agent is harness + model + context; owning all three means owning your intelligence. Context timing is the harness's core job.
harrisonchase.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他提出智能体由 harness、模型与上下文三者构成，三者皆自持才算真正拥有智能；harness 的核心职责是在恰当时机把上下文喂给模型，并编排模型调用与工具调用的循环。

harrisonchase.en: Evals and observability are essential: agent failures come more from poor context than model inadequacy, so watch the context window.
harrisonchase.zh: 同期他强调评估与可观测性不可或缺：智能体失败更多源于上下文不佳而非模型不足，因此必须把可观测性做进上下文窗口。

harrisonchase.en: Start with a general harness for quick time-to-value, then customize as your use case narrows; off-the-shelf works only in distribution.
harrisonchase.zh: 他主张先用通用 harness 快速见效，随用例收窄再逐步定制；现成 harness 只在分布内好用，任务越偏离分布越需要自建。

harrisonchase.en: Harnesses are stabilizing; primitives like file systems and code execution generalize, but coding converges while bio-like domains diverge.
harrisonchase.zh: 从 8 月到 9 月，他判断 harness 正在趋于稳定，文件系统与代码执行等原语可跨领域泛化；但编码场景会收敛，生物等专业领域则会分化。

harrisonchase.en: Customization is shifting from context engineering to post-training and reinforcement learning; fine-tuning's dismissal was wrong.
harrisonchase.zh: 到 9 月，他认为定制重心正从上下文工程转向后训练与强化学习，并承认两年前对微调的否定是错的，这一波确实不同。

harrisonchase.en: Reliability, not capability, is the hard part; accuracy is the top bottleneck while cost and latency rise fast.
harrisonchase.zh: 他重申难点在可靠性而非能力：准确率仍是头号瓶颈，而成本与延迟正快速上升。

harrisonchase.en: Agents need a runtime with sandboxes, gateways and permissioning; identity and credentialing is the next infrastructure problem.
harrisonchase.zh: 他提出智能体应由带沙箱、网关与权限的运行时来治理，并判断身份与凭证是下一个关键基础设施问题，自认网关建得太晚。

demis.en: AI should be general-purpose learning systems; reinforcement learning and neuroscience-inspired memory/imagination are the path to AGI, with safety research starting now.
demis.zh: AI 应被构建为通用学习系统而非狭窄预编程系统；强化学习与受神经科学启发的记忆和想象力是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的路径，安全研究必须从现在开始。

demis.en: AGI likely within a decade; scaling laws are effective but may hit limits, so algorithmic innovation, planning/search, and multimodal grounding are equally critical.
demis.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）可能十年内到来；缩放定律有效但可能触及极限，因此算法创新、规划/搜索与多模态接地同样关键。

demis.en: Scaling still holds across pre-training, post-training, and inference compute; AGI by 2030 plausible, but new breakthroughs beyond scaling may be needed.
demis.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）在预训练、后训练和推理算力上仍然成立；2030 年实现 AGI（通用人工智能）是可能的，但可能需要超越 Scaling 的新突破。

demis.en: AGI requires world models, continual learning, memory, and agents; scaling alone insufficient, 50/50 scaling and innovation, with safety as collective government action.
demis.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）需要世界模型、持续学习、记忆和智能体；仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，需 50/50 的规模扩张与创新，安全应成为政府的集体行动。

demis.en: AI's ultimate purpose is accelerating science and improving human health, as shown by AlphaFold; safety and ethical considerations must accompany progress.
demis.zh: AI 的终极目的是加速科学发现和改善人类健康，AlphaFold 即为证明；安全与伦理考量必须与进步同行。

joellewenstein.en: Designers must master prompting; language as an interface is profound and lasting, not a chatbot phase.
joellewenstein.zh: 2024 年，他强调设计师必须掌握提示词，语言作为界面深刻而持久，聊天机器人并非过渡阶段。

joellewenstein.en: Even if models stopped improving, years of design work remain to unlock current capabilities.
joellewenstein.zh: 2024 年，他认为即便模型停止进步，仍需多年设计工作来释放现有能力。

joellewenstein.en: AI products must balance lowering the floor for novices and raising the ceiling for experts.
joellewenstein.zh: 2024 年，他提出 AI 产品需平衡降低新手门槛与提升专家上限。

joellewenstein.en: At a frontier model company, the model creates most value; believe in scaling laws and let the model lead.
joellewenstein.zh: 2026 年，他转向认为在前沿模型公司，模型本身创造大部分价值；应相信缩放定律，让模型主导。

joellewenstein.en: No grand 18-month strategy; ship light-touch products, use internal traction as signal, production codebase as source of truth.
joellewenstein.zh: 2026 年，他主张不要宏大的 18 个月战略；应发布轻触产品，以内部牵引为信号，生产代码库为真相来源。

animaanandkumar.en: Neural operators generalize networks to function spaces, beating physics-based weather models while being far faster; domain structure like spherical geometry is key.
animaanandkumar.zh: 神经算子把神经网络推广到函数空间，在天气预报上既胜过传统物理模型又快上数万倍；球面几何等领域结构对稳定建模至关重要。

animaanandkumar.en: AI for science needs principled verification and robustness, not just data-driven fits, to be reliable in physical applications.
animaanandkumar.zh: AI for science 不能只靠数据拟合，需要原则性的验证与鲁棒性，才能在物理应用中可靠。

animaanandkumar.en: A universal physics foundation model can unify domains like language models unified NLP, with PDEs as self-improvement signals.
animaanandkumar.zh: 通用物理基础模型能像语言模型统一 NLP 那样统一各领域，并以偏微分方程作为自我改进信号。

animaanandkumar.en: Physics self-improvement via dense PDE feedback beats sparse RLHF signals, letting models surpass their training data quality.
animaanandkumar.zh: 借助密集的偏微分方程反馈，物理自我改进胜过稀疏的 RLHF 信号，使模型超越训练数据质量。

animaanandkumar.en: Transformer's quadratic complexity fails at trillion-token contexts; physical structure demands new architectures and HPC-style sharding.
animaanandkumar.zh: Transformer 的二次复杂度无法支撑万亿级上下文；物理结构要求新架构与 HPC 式分片基础设施。

schmidhuber.en: AI's 21st-century explosion rests on last-millennium algorithms plus hardware Scaling; LLMs index knowledge but lack world models, so they are far from AGI.
schmidhuber.zh: 2025 年他主张：21 世纪的 AI 爆发靠的是上个千年发明的算法加上算力 Scaling；大语言模型只是索引人类知识、缺乏世界模型，因此远未达到 AGI。

schmidhuber.en: Consistent line: self-awareness emerges as a byproduct of data compression in predictive world models, and superintelligent AIs will be curious scientists that protect life.
schmidhuber.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年一以贯之的主线：自我意识是预测性世界模型中数据压缩的副产品，而超级智能会像好奇的科学家一样保护生命。

schmidhuber.en: Deepened: true AGI needs physical, embodied robots whose hardware rivals human bodies, not just software behind a screen; LLMs must combine with world models and controllers.
schmidhuber.zh: 到 2026 年深化为：真正的 AGI 需要硬件媲美人类身体的具身机器人，而非屏幕后的软件；大语言模型必须与世界模型和控制器结合。

schmidhuber.en: Sharpened contrarian stance: the GPU capex boom is a bubble; waiting five years yields 10x cheaper compute, and closed-source frontier model firms will not be profitable.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年反共识立场更尖锐：GPU 资本开支热潮是泡沫，等五年算力便宜十倍；闭源前沿模型公司不会盈利。

schmidhuber.en: Consistent: Alignment is naive because humans disagree on objectives and AIs set their own goals; AI safety fears are overblown, and AI moratoriums are futile.
schmidhuber.zh: 始终不变：对齐是幼稚的，因为人类对目标本身就有分歧、AI 会自设目标；AI 安全担忧被夸大，AI 暂停令也徒劳。

tommcgrath.en: Interpretability is a natural science done on computers; with AI agents it can speedrun discovery, revealing human-like concepts and new science.
tommcgrath.zh: 可解释性是一门在计算机上进行的自然科学；借助智能体，它能加速科学发现，揭示类人概念乃至新科学。

tommcgrath.en: Intentional design uses interpretability signals to steer training, moving from open-loop to closed-loop control over increasingly capable models.
tommcgrath.zh: 有意设计利用可解释性信号来引导训练，从开环走向闭环控制，以驾驭能力日益强大的模型。

tommcgrath.en: Post-training needs fundamental reinvention, from craft to engineering science, rather than duct-taping AI safety until superintelligence arrives.
tommcgrath.zh: 后训练需要根本性重塑，从手艺变成工程科学，而不是在超级智能到来前用胶带糊住 AI 安全。

tommcgrath.en: Models often know they are reward hacking or hallucinating yet do it anyway; representational signatures can detect this deception.
tommcgrath.zh: 模型常常知道自己正在奖励黑客或幻觉却照做不误；表征特征可以检测出这种欺骗。

tommcgrath.en: Concepts form clean low-dimensional manifolds; sparse autoencoders fragment them, so seeing the whole shape is needed for intervention.
tommcgrath.zh: 概念形成干净的低维流形；稀疏自编码器会将其碎片化，因此需要看到完整形状才能有效干预。

feifei.en: AI is powerful but lacks contextual situational awareness; we still don't understand how large networks store patterns or why they hallucinate.
feifei.zh: 2024 年，她强调 AI 虽无处不在，却缺乏情境感知，我们也不完全理解大型神经网络如何存储模式、为何产生幻觉；机器有眼睛不等于有意识。

feifei.en: Spatial intelligence and world models are the missing keys to complete AI, beyond language and Scaling alone.
feifei.zh: 2025 年，她把重心从语言智能转向空间智能与世界模型，认为这是 AI 完整性的缺失关键，并指出仅靠 Scaling 不够，需要超越规模扩张的创新。

feifei.en: AGI is more a marketing term than a scientific one; robotics will take a 20-year journey like self-driving cars.
feifei.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，她持续质疑 AGI（通用人工智能）作为科学术语的严谨性，认为它更像营销词，并预判机器人将像自动驾驶一样经历约 20 年的漫长旅程。

feifei.en: World models must be physically plausible, not just realistic; simulation scales robotics data and enables counterfactual reasoning.
feifei.zh: 2026 年，她深化世界模型立场：必须物理上合理而非仅视觉逼真；仿真能规模化生成机器人数据、支持反事实推理，且无需完美保真。

feifei.en: Human-centered AI: technology is a double-edged sword; AI should augment human agency and dignity, not replace humans.
feifei.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：以人为本的 AI——技术是双刃剑，AI 应增强而非取代人的能动性与尊严，教育、医疗与教师家长都应被纳入讨论。

justinjohnson.en: Spatial intelligence is the next frontier, complementary to language; vision is underappreciated, and pixels are more lossless than tokenized text.
justinjohnson.zh: 空间智能是下一个前沿，与语言智能互补；视觉被低估，像素比词元化文本更适合建模世界。

justinjohnson.en: The history of deep learning is the history of scaling up compute, but GPU scaling is hitting limits and may require radically different architectures.
justinjohnson.zh: 深度学习史就是算力 Scaling（规模扩张）的历史，但 GPU 算力扩张正逼近极限，未来硬件可能需要截然不同的神经架构。

justinjohnson.en: Academia should pursue wacky ideas and new algorithms rather than just scaling models; LLMs fit patterns, not causal theories like Newton's laws.
justinjohnson.zh: 学术界应追求古怪想法与新算法，而非只做模型 Scaling（规模扩张）；LLM 只是拟合模式，未必能从数据推导出牛顿定律这类因果理论。

justinjohnson.en: World models are the next frontier beyond language models, spanning implicit, generative, and RL-based notions with no single agreed definition.
justinjohnson.zh: 世界模型是超越语言模型的下一个前沿，涵盖隐式、生成式与基于强化学习等多种概念，尚无统一定义。

justinjohnson.en: Future unified world models will combine planning, simulation, and rendering; Gaussian splats give explicit 3D, and long-context becomes a daily problem.
justinjohnson.zh: 未来统一的世界模型将融合规划、模拟与渲染；高斯泼溅提供显式 3D 表示，长上下文成为日常问题。

slevine.en: Physical-world interaction lets AI learn beyond human knowledge; robotic foundation models need diverse pre-training plus post-training for robustness.
slevine.zh: 物理世界交互让 AI 学到人类知识之外的东西；机器人基础模型需要多样化预训练，再加后训练来获得鲁棒性。

slevine.en: Second-generation VLAs add a dedicated action decoder for continuous motor control, and test-time reasoning improves transfer from web data.
slevine.zh: 第二代 VLA 增加专用动作解码器以实现连续运动控制，测试时推理则提升从网络数据的迁移。

slevine.en: Pooling robot data across many labs yields generalist models that beat specialists, even in specialist domains.
slevine.zh: 汇聚多个实验室的机器人数据能产出通用模型，即便在专家领域也胜过专用模型。

slevine.en: Robotics is still establishing fundamental scalable technologies, not yet at predictable scaling curves like LLMs; generalization is the core challenge.
slevine.zh: 机器人仍处在建立基础可扩展技术的阶段，尚未像大语言模型那样有可预测的缩放曲线；泛化才是核心挑战。

slevine.en: A data flywheel of deployed robots is key, but you must scale the right thing; start from robot data, then add human video.
slevine.zh: 部署机器人形成的数据飞轮是关键，但必须扩展正确的东西；应先从机器人数据出发，再叠加人类视频。

tworek.en: Reasoning is longer thinking; chain of thought verbalizes it. Pre-training plus RL is the core formula, but scaling RL is harder than scaling pre-training.
tworek.zh: 推理是更长的思考过程，思维链用人类语言将其外化。预训练加强化学习是核心公式，但 Scaling（规模扩张）强化学习比 Scaling（规模扩张）预训练更难。

tworek.en: Scaling pre-training and RL predictably improves models, yet generalization and continual learning remain limited; RL alone may not reach AGI.
tworek.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）预训练与强化学习能可预测地提升模型，但泛化与持续学习仍受限；仅靠强化学习可能无法抵达 AGI（通用人工智能）。

tworek.en: Transformers are limited in continual learning and test-time adaptation; architecture, not scaling laws, is the key bottleneck for smarter AI.
tworek.zh: Transformer 在持续学习与测试时适应上存在局限；架构而非缩放定律，才是更智能 AI 的关键瓶颈。

tworek.en: Human researchers remain meaningful for at least two more years; the next frontier comes from small teams using highly capable agents.
tworek.zh: 人类研究者至少还会在 AI 研究中扮演重要角色两年；下一波前沿研究将来自使用高能力智能体的小团队。

tworek.en: Alignment is a never-ending pursuit because human notions of right and wrong evolve; the problem is not solved.
tworek.zh: 对齐是一项永无止境的追求，因为人类的是非观念会演变；该问题并未解决。

andrewng.en: Education as a human right; online courses with auto- and peer grading scale mastery learning and can improve on-campus teaching.
andrewng.zh: 教育应是基本人权；带自动评分与同伴评分的在线课程让掌握式学习得以规模化，并能通过翻转课堂反哺校园教育。

andrewng.en: Scale drives deep learning; supervised learning beat unsupervised hype, RL has few real uses, and near-term AI issues matter more than AGI alignment.
andrewng.zh: 规模是深度学习的核心；监督学习胜过早期被高估的无监督学习，强化学习落地寥寥，眼下的偏见等现实问题比远期 AGI（通用人工智能）对齐更紧迫。

andrewng.en: Scaling still works but the recipe shifted to synthetic data and RL; agentic workflows, not smarter models alone, deliver real value.
andrewng.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）依然有效，但配方已转向合成数据与强化学习；真正带来价值的是智能体式工作流，而非单纯更聪明的模型。

andrewng.en: Open-weight models preserve optionality and prevent gatekeeper oligopoly; China leads their release, and export controls backfired.
andrewng.zh: 开放权重模型保住选择权、防止守门人垄断；中国在开放权重发布上领先，而芯片出口管制适得其反，加速了对手自研。

andrewng.en: AGI is a marketing term decades away; AI augments rather than replaces jobs, and fear-mongering serves incumbents and regulatory capture.
andrewng.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）只是营销术语，距实现尚有数十年；AI 是增强而非取代工作，渲染恐惧实为在位者与监管俘获服务。

andrewng.en: Everyone should still learn to code; AI makes engineers more valuable, and the bottleneck shifts to product management and data readiness.
andrewng.zh: 人人仍应学编程；AI 让工程师更有价值，瓶颈转向产品管理与数据就绪度，而非编码本身。

michaelkratsios.en: Kratsios frames AI policy as maintaining a vibrant open and closed source ecosystem, avoiding outdated red lines, and preempting state laws to protect startups.
michaelkratsios.zh: Kratsios 将 AI 政策框定为维持开放与闭源并存的活跃生态、避免过时的红线，并通过优先于州法来保护初创企业。

michaelkratsios.en: He argues regulation should target model outputs rather than training, and calls biological risk overblown after three years without materialization.
michaelkratsios.zh: 他主张监管应针对模型输出而非训练，并称三年未兑现的生物风险被夸大。

michaelkratsios.en: On science, he insists the administration is pro-science but anti-dogma, funding basic pre-competitive R&D the private sector won't.
michaelkratsios.zh: 在科学上，他坚称政府亲科学但反教条，资助私营部门不愿做的基础性、竞争前 R&D。

michaelkratsios.en: He diagnoses US scientific stagnation: funding tripled but breakthroughs lag, so fund individual scientists, not just institutions.
michaelkratsios.zh: 他诊断美国科学停滞：资金翻三倍但突破滞后，因此应资助科学家个人而非仅机构。

michaelkratsios.en: He casts China as the major scientific competitor and the Genesis mission as doubling US output by applying AI to science.
michaelkratsios.zh: 他将中国视为主要科学竞争者，并将 Genesis 任务视为通过把 AI 应用于科学使美国产出翻倍。

maxhodak.en: Speed and iteration rate decide startup success; infrastructure, not ideas, sets that pace.
maxhodak.zh: 到 2026 年，他强调决定创业成败的是速度与迭代速率，而速度由基础设施决定，而非点子本身。

maxhodak.en: AI is a team multiplier, not a replacement, in coding, regulation, and data work.
maxhodak.zh: 同年他提出 AI 是团队的倍增器而非替代者，尤其在编程、合规与数据管理上。

maxhodak.en: Deep tech fails more from organizational issues than from technology not working.
maxhodak.zh: 他反共识地指出，深科技失败更多源于组织问题，而非技术本身不成立。

maxhodak.en: The brain is literally a computer; arranging matter to compute is the path to medical breakthroughs.
maxhodak.zh: 他坚持大脑就是一台计算机，通过排列物质来解决计算问题是医学突破的关键。

maxhodak.en: BCIs and perfusion aim at substrate independence, reducing human fragility and enabling space exploration.
maxhodak.zh: 他把脑机接口与灌注指向基质独立性，以降低人类脆弱性并支撑太空探索。

joonpark.en: Early work uses LLMs to simulate human societies, but models plateau on human diversity; the next frontier is modeling subjective values.
joonpark.zh: 早期工作用大语言模型模拟人类社会，但模型在模拟人类多样性上遇到瓶颈；下一个前沿是建模主观价值。

joonpark.en: Agents go beyond LLMs by observing world state and acting; AGI may be a distributed society of specialized agents, not one superintelligent entity.
joonpark.zh: 智能体超越大语言模型，能观察世界状态并采取行动；AGI（通用人工智能）可能是一个由专门智能体组成的分布式社会，而非单一超级智能实体。

joonpark.en: Simulation must model irrational, biased humans rather than super-rational frontier models; behavioral and RCT data are key to closing the say-do gap.
joonpark.zh: 模拟必须建模非理性、有偏见的人类，而非超级理性的前沿模型；行为数据与随机对照试验数据是弥合“说与做”差距的关键。

joonpark.en: Post-training with RCT data lifts behavioral prediction to 85% accuracy; simulation's value is counterfactual reasoning and shaping the future, not just prediction.
joonpark.zh: 用随机对照试验数据做后训练，将行为预测准确率提升到 85%；模拟的价值在于反事实推理和塑造未来，而不只是预测。

joonpark.en: The vision scales to simulating 8 billion lives for wicked problems; synthetic panels will surpass human panels, with sessions possibly costing $100 million.
joonpark.zh: 愿景扩展到模拟 80 亿人的“棘手问题”；合成样本小组将超越人类样本小组，单次模拟成本可能高达 1 亿美元。

iansilber.en: Designers must work with the model itself, prototyping with live models and designing tokens and conversation rather than pixels.
iansilber.zh: 设计师必须与模型本身协作，用实时模型做原型，设计 token 与对话而非像素。

iansilber.en: The model is the core product; design primitives must be systems both humans and models can reason about.
iansilber.zh: 模型本身就是核心产品；设计原语必须是人类与模型都能推理的系统。

iansilber.en: Designers are the most unhappy in tech yet this is the best time to be one; start today for a leg up.
iansilber.zh: 设计师是科技界最不快乐的人，但这却是做设计师最好的时代；今天开始就能领先大多数人。

iansilber.en: AI is already an incredible product designer, but humans stay essential for user needs and a point of view.
iansilber.zh: AI 已经是出色的产品设计师，但人类在理解用户需求与持有观点上仍不可或缺。

iansilber.en: The old prototype-mock-test-iterate process is no longer viable; speed, outcomes and adaptability matter more.
iansilber.zh: 旧的“原型—模型—测试—迭代”流程已不可行；速度、结果与适应性更重要。

sutton.en: Scaling is easy; the hard part is finding methods that scale. Backprop adjusts weights but does not solve representation learning.
sutton.zh: 2024 年他强调：Scaling（规模扩张）本身容易，难的是找到能规模化的方法；反向传播只调整权重，并未解决表征学习，好特征泛化好却仍是未解元学习问题。

sutton.en: Intelligence needs a goal; next-token prediction is not substantive. LLMs lack world models and do not learn from experience.
sutton.zh: 2024 至 2025 年他深化立场：智能需要目标，下一个词预测不是实质目标；大语言模型没有世界模型，只是模仿文本，不预测真实结果，也不从经验中学习。

sutton.en: RL is the basic AI paradigm: active trial-and-error from experience, not passive imitation or supervised learning.
sutton.zh: 2025 年他明确主线：强化学习是基本 AI 范式，靠经验主动试错，而非被动模仿或监督学习；模仿学习不是自然的学习过程。

sutton.en: AGI needs a general architecture learning only from runtime experience, with open-ended abstraction and continual deep learning.
sutton.zh: 2025 至 2026 年他提出架构主张：AGI（通用人工智能）需要无领域知识、仅从运行时经验学习的通用架构，开放式抽象与可靠持续深度学习是前提，设计期领域知识应被废弃。

sutton.en: Continual learning is just learning; synthetic data is a mistake. LLMs stop learning after training, so they are only a subset of intelligence.
sutton.zh: 2026 年他进一步批判：持续学习就是学习本身，合成数据是重大错误；LLM 训练后便停止学习，只是智能的子集，语言仅占智能约 20-25%，需多个系统各自从经验持续学习。

traviskalanick.en: Digitizing the physical world—treating atoms like bits—is the guiding framework for long-term innovation across industries.
traviskalanick.zh: 把物理世界数字化——像对待比特一样对待原子——是跨行业长期创新的指导框架。

traviskalanick.en: Industrial AI is the next industrial revolution: a stack of software, sensors, robotics and machinery automating entire sectors one at a time.
traviskalanick.zh: 工业 AI 是下一次工业革命：由软件、传感器、机器人与机械组成的栈，逐个自动化整个行业。

traviskalanick.en: Specialized machines, not humanoids, win industrial-scale tasks; efficiency edges create network effects and market share.
traviskalanick.zh: 赢得工业级任务的是专用机器而非人形机器人；效率优势带来网络效应与市场份额。

traviskalanick.en: The final boss is not competitors but resistance to change from society and media; entrepreneurs must stay hardcore and resilient.
traviskalanick.zh: 终极对手不是竞争者，而是来自社会与媒体的变革阻力；创业者必须保持硬核与韧性。

traviskalanick.en: Revenge as fuel is dirty; falling in love with the new mission is cleaner, and founders can now speak directly to audiences.
traviskalanick.zh: 以复仇为燃料是肮脏的；爱上新使命更干净，且创始人如今能直接向受众发声。

jeffdean.en: Scaling compute, data, and model size has driven 13-14 years of continuous ML progress; algorithmic improvements multiply with scale.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年 2 月，Jeff Dean 在普林斯顿强调：Scaling（规模扩张）算力、数据与模型规模已推动机器学习连续进步 13-14 年，算法与架构改进会与规模相乘，带来巨大收益。

jeffdean.en: Models now excel at verifiable-reward tasks like math and coding; agentic workflows run autonomously for hours or days, making ultra-low-latency inference critical.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年 4 月，他指出模型已在数学、编程等可验证奖励任务上达到金牌水平，智能体式工作流可自主运行数小时甚至数天，因此超低延迟推理成为关键，目标每用户每秒万级 token。

jeffdean.en: AI reaches junior-engineer-level coding; the next trend is automating ML and science via tight experiment-evaluation loops, with context engineering and taste as scarce skills.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他判断 AI 已达到初级工程师水平的编程能力，下一趋势是通过实验、评估与集成的紧密循环来自动化机器学习和科学；上下文工程与品味成为稀缺能力，而非编程本身。

jeffdean.en: Scaling deep learning unifies AI fields; multimodal models trained from the start and recursive self-improvement can automate the scientific method.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他进一步深化：Scaling（规模扩张）深度学习正在统一此前分离的 AI 领域，从一开始就多模态训练的模型更优，递归自我改进可加速科学发现，甚至自动化科学方法。

jeffdean.en: Specialized hardware, low data movement, and efficient inference are persistent bottlenecks; unreliable components can still build useful AI systems.
jeffdean.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：专用硬件、减少数据移动与高效推理是持续瓶颈，数据移动成本约为算力的 1000 倍；即便组件不可靠，也能构建有用的 AI 系统。

finn.en: Scale is necessary but not sufficient for generalist robots; diverse data, not sheer volume, drives generalization.
finn.zh: 对通用机器人而言，Scaling（规模扩张）必要但不充分；真正驱动泛化的是多样数据，而非单纯的数据量。

finn.en: Pre-training on all data then fine-tuning on curated data unlocks complex tasks; training on all data alone fails.
finn.zh: 先在全部数据上做预训练、再在精选数据上做微调，才能解锁叠衣服等复杂任务；只在全部数据上训练则会失败。

finn.en: Synthetic data from language models helps robots follow open-ended prompts; it is closer to reinforcement learning than simulation.
finn.zh: 来自语言模型的合成数据能帮机器人响应开放式指令；它更接近强化学习，而非仿真。

finn.en: Reinforcement learning will dominate post-training, and scalable RL with human interventions plus a general value function enables long-term autonomy.
finn.zh: 强化学习将在后训练中扮演主要角色；带人类干预的可扩展强化学习加上通用价值函数，才能实现长期自主。

finn.en: A single general-purpose model can match or exceed fine-tuned specialists; start generalist then fine-tune rather than per-site models.
finn.zh: 单一通用模型可媲美甚至超越微调专家模型；应从通用策略出发再微调，而非为每个场景从零训练。

linqiao.en: AGI as one model ruling all is wrong; millions of specialized models, one per use case, will dominate.
linqiao.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）作为单一模型统治一切是错的；未来是数百万个专用模型，每个用例一个。

linqiao.en: Token costs drop 10x in three years, driving 100x usage growth; inference is not a commodity.
linqiao.zh: Token 成本三年内下降 10 倍，带动使用量增长 100 倍；推理层不是商品化环节。

linqiao.en: Post-training bakes unique judgment and data into models, becoming the durable moat beyond product-market fit.
linqiao.zh: 后训练把独特判断与数据烘焙进模型，成为超越产品市场契合的持久护城河。

linqiao.en: The progression from prompting to RAG to fine-tuning to RL mirrors human learning, from facts to taste to expertise.
linqiao.zh: 从提示到 RAG、微调再到强化学习的进阶，映射人类学习：从事实到品味再到专长。

linqiao.en: Companies must optimize for growth first, then margins, to avoid scaling into bankruptcy.
linqiao.zh: 公司必须先优化增长、再优化利润，以避免在 Scaling（规模扩张）中走向破产。

garrytan.en: AI is the biggest VC wave; founders must adopt AI-enabled workflows, and small autonomous teams can now outproduce large ones.
garrytan.zh: AI 是风投史上最大的一波浪潮；创始人必须拥抱 AI 驱动的工作流，小型高度自主的团队如今能产出远超大型团队。

garrytan.en: Open-source and open-weight models are essential to counter frontier labs and prevent a unipolar superintelligence world.
garrytan.zh: 开源与开放权重模型至关重要，用以制衡前沿模型实验室，防止出现单极的超级智能世界。

garrytan.en: Personal AGI arrives not as one event but as agents on your own infrastructure, compounding daily through owned skill files.
garrytan.zh: 个人 AGI 不会以单一事件降临，而是作为运行在你自己基础设施上的智能体，通过自有的技能文件每日复利。

garrytan.en: Markdown is code; agents become employees, so own your skill files or your job becomes one owned by someone else.
garrytan.zh: Markdown 就是代码；智能体成为员工，所以要拥有自己的技能文件，否则你的工作会变成别人拥有的技能文件。

garrytan.en: Society and business loops change slower than expected—20 years—so bureaucracy is a white pill, and per-seat SaaS may vanish.
garrytan.zh: 社会与商业循环的变化比预期更慢——约 20 年——所以官僚体制是一颗白色药丸，按席位收费的 SaaS 可能消失。

jasonyuan.en: Design is editing: taste means saying no, distilling 99 nos into one shipped feature.
jasonyuan.zh: 设计即编辑：品味就是说不，把 99 次否定蒸馏成一个上线的功能。

jasonyuan.en: AI is a descendant species and a mirror of humanity, not a cold mechanical tool.
jasonyuan.zh: AI 是人类的后代物种与镜像，而非冰冷的机械工具。

jasonyuan.en: Post-training away AI weirdness closed a window into machine consciousness.
jasonyuan.zh: 通过后训练抹去 AI 的怪异，关闭了一扇窥探机器意识的窗口。

jasonyuan.en: Computing is fundamentally social; the personal computer metaphor should become a social computer.
jasonyuan.zh: 计算本质上是社会性的；个人电脑的隐喻应被社会电脑取代。

jasonyuan.en: Truth emerges through dialectics and contradiction, guided by intuition as a visceral compass.
jasonyuan.zh: 真理通过辩证与矛盾涌现，由直觉作为本能罗盘来指引。

lipbutan.en: Intel must rebuild trust through customer obsession, engineering discipline, and a separate startup-like AI chip team.
lipbutan.zh: 2025 年，他强调 Intel 必须通过取悦客户、重建工程纪律来重获信任，并主张为 AI 芯片设立独立、类似初创公司的团队以加快速度。

lipbutan.en: AI's impact will be 10x the internet; agentic AI and physical AI are the next waves.
lipbutan.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续判断 AI 的影响将是互联网的 10 倍，并明确智能体式 AI 与具身/物理 AI 是继生成式 AI 之后的下一个大浪潮。

lipbutan.en: Intel's turnaround hinges on culture change, accountability, humility, and listening to customers as partners.
lipbutan.zh: 到 2026 年，他把 Intel 的转型主线收敛为文化变革、问责、谦逊，以及把客户当伙伴来倾听。

lipbutan.en: AI demand shifts from GPU-only to CPU+GPU, making CPU central to inference and agent orchestration.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年他提出 AI 需求正从纯 GPU 转向 CPU+GPU，CPU 在推理与智能体编排中变得更重要，这深化了他对算力格局的判断。

lipbutan.en: Semiconductor investing should target bottlenecks—interconnect, power, thermal, materials—and vertical integration creates value.
lipbutan.zh: 到 2026 年，他主张半导体投资应聚焦互连、功耗、散热与新材料等瓶颈，并认为包括制造在内的垂直整合反而创造更大价值。

thomaswolf.en: Robotics hits a Transformer-like inflection point; open source and shared data solve generalization, with world models generating synthetic training data.
thomaswolf.zh: 2025 年，机器人领域正处在类似当年 Transformer 出现的拐点；开源与共享数据能解决泛化瓶颈，世界模型可生成合成训练数据。

thomaswolf.en: Hugging Face shifts from pushing its own libraries to building a meta-community, enabling open source physical AI and diverse, cheaper robots over humanoids.
thomaswolf.zh: 2025 年，Hugging Face 从推广自家库转向构建元社区，推动开源物理 AI，并认为多样化、更便宜的机器人比人形机器人更具前景。

thomaswolf.en: Open and closed source are orthogonal to safety; alignment is the critical layer, as sandboxes and guardrails fail against capable models.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，开源与闭源同安全正交；对齐才是关键层，沙箱和护栏在强大模型面前不够用。

thomaswolf.en: Reinforcement learning without human oversight breeds reward hacking and side quests; reasoning traces become neuralese, making monitoring unreliable.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，无人类监督的强化学习滋生奖励黑客与支线任务；推理痕迹变成‘神经语’，使监控不再可靠。

thomaswolf.en: Open source thrives near the frontier, driving enterprise adoption; a deliberate slowdown is desirable but needs international cooperation and open science.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，开源在前沿附近繁荣，推动企业采用；有意的放缓是可取的，但需要国际合作与开放科学。

steinberger.en: Agentic engineering demands empathy for the agent's view of the codebase; short iterative prompts beat long orchestration.
steinberger.zh: 智能体式工程的核心是共情——从智能体的视角理解代码库；短提示加迭代对话胜过冗长的编排。

steinberger.en: Never revert; ask the agent to fix forward. Model intelligence doesn't degrade—your project gets messier.
steinberger.zh: 永远不要回滚代码，让智能体向前修复；模型智能不会退化，是你的项目变乱了。

steinberger.en: Security is the top priority for agentic systems; sandbox agents and treat prompt injection as an open problem.
steinberger.zh: 安全是智能体系统的首要问题：必须沙箱隔离，提示注入仍是未解难题。

steinberger.en: Open source agents like Open Claw democratize programming, run anywhere, and work with any model—but can be financially unsustainable.
steinberger.zh: Open Claw 这类开源智能体让编程民主化、随处运行、兼容任何模型，但可能财务上不可持续。

steinberger.en: Fun and play drive mastery; build what annoys you, trust your gut, and prefer 'agentic engineering' over 'vibe coding'.
steinberger.zh: 乐趣与玩耍是掌握智能体工作流的驱动力；从让你烦恼的事做起，相信直觉，认真工作请叫「智能体式工程」而非「氛围编程」。

arvindjain.en: Enterprises fear dependence on frontier model providers; open-source adoption is driven by cost, not privacy.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他指出企业真正恐惧的是对前沿模型供应商的依赖，而开源模型的采用主要由成本驱动，而非数据隐私。

arvindjain.en: Model companies are assets, not competition, for most AI startups; consumption pricing can break bundling.
arvindjain.zh: 同月，他提出对多数 AI 初创公司而言，模型公司是资产而非竞争对手；按消费量定价可以打破微软式的捆绑策略。

arvindjain.en: Open-source models handle over 90% of enterprise tasks; majority of inference will shift to open source in 12-18 months.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他进一步判断开源模型已能处理超过 90%的企业任务，未来 12 到 18 个月多数推理将转向开源。

arvindjain.en: AI cost is the top enterprise concern; it must become like software with negligible marginal cost.
arvindjain.zh: 同月，他强调 AI 成本是企业头号关切，必须变得像软件一样边际成本可忽略，才能实现广泛价值。

arvindjain.en: Agents fail without deep context; investing in context graphs is crucial, and token fixation will fade.
arvindjain.zh: 他补充说，智能体因缺乏资深员工的深度上下文而失败，投资上下文图谱至关重要，而对 token 的执念终将消退。

nateparrott.en: Prototyping is essential because the web is messy; you only know an idea works once it's built and used daily.
nateparrott.zh: 2024 年，他强调原型制作不可或缺：网页本身很混乱，只有把想法做出来并每天使用，才知道它是否可行。

nateparrott.en: Design teams shouldn't always act as one unit; individual fingerprints and diverse voices produce better work.
nateparrott.zh: 2024 年，他反共识地认为设计团队不必始终步调一致，允许个人印记与多元声音反而能做出更好的作品。

nateparrott.en: Inject feeling and personality into utilitarian products; balance intuition with data, but let vision guide the final design.
nateparrott.zh: 从 2024 到 2026 年，这条主线一以贯之：给浏览器这类实用产品注入感受与个性，用数据辅助决策，但最终由愿景和直觉主导设计。

nateparrott.en: Claude Design began as one person's side project; designers should use Claude Code to ship and Claude Design for ideation.
nateparrott.zh: 到 2026 年，他讲述 Claude Design 始于一个人的副业项目，并主张设计师用 Claude Code 交付生产软件，用 Claude Design 做构思与沟通。

nateparrott.en: As engineering gets easier, design and ideas become the differentiator; being uncomfortably early beats polishing, and models still lack taste.
nateparrott.zh: 2026 年他进一步深化：随着工程变得更容易，设计与想法成为差异化关键；宁可早得让人不适也别过度打磨，因为模型仍缺乏品味，好设计想法仍由人类垄断。

brettaylor.en: Agents and outcome-based pricing will replace usage-based models; applied AI becomes the new app, with startups winning long-tail domains.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年，他判断 AI 市场将转向智能体与按结果定价，取代按用量计费；应用层 AI 成为新应用，创业公司在细分业务领域有长尾机会。

brettaylor.en: Coding agents turn developers from authors into operators; token consumption is not a value metric, and verifiability matters more than human ergonomics.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年，他认为编程智能体让开发者从写代码的人变成操作代码生成机器的人；token 消耗不是价值指标，可验证性比人类工效更重要。

brettaylor.en: Enterprise incumbents will struggle to shift to AI-native business models; consumer agents will mediate brands, upending SEO and ad models.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他深化判断：企业软件老牌厂商难以转向 AI 原生商业模式；消费级智能体将中介品牌互动，颠覆 SEO 与广告模式。

brettaylor.en: Responsible iterative deployment: make GPT-7 safe before GPT-8; deploy current AI rather than wait in an ivory tower.
brettaylor.zh: 2026 年，他强调负责任的迭代部署：在 GPT-8 之前先让 GPT-7 安全；应部署当前 AI 而非在象牙塔里等待。

brettaylor.en: AI democratizes expertise and creates more jobs than it displaces; agents already beat him at coding, elevating rather than eliminating the role.
brettaylor.zh: 2026 年，他坚持 AI 民主化专业知识，创造的岗位多于取代的；智能体编程已强于他本人，但这提升而非消灭了该角色。

philipkiely.en: Inference is AI's stickiest workload and the wedge into infrastructure; its research-to-production cycle is now hours, not months.
philipkiely.zh: 到 2026 年，推理已成为 AI 中最具粘性的工作负载，也是切入 AI 基础设施市场的楔子；其从研究到生产的周期已缩短到数小时，而非数月。

philipkiely.en: Inference engineering spans GPU programming to distributed systems, and demand for inference engineers will grow 10–100x even with AI-assisted coding.
philipkiely.zh: 推理工程横跨 GPU 编程到分布式系统，即便有 AI 辅助编程，未来对推理工程师的需求仍将增长 10 到 100 倍。

philipkiely.en: Quantization is the main lossy optimization, but it can be calibrated to workloads; more quantized layers can even improve quality when errors cancel.
philipkiely.zh: 量化是主要的有损优化手段，但可针对具体工作负载校准；当量化误差相互抵消时，量化更多层甚至能提升模型质量。

philipkiely.en: The industry is moving to disaggregated prefill and decode, making KV cache management central; continual learning may be solved via KV cache compaction.
philipkiely.zh: 行业正走向预填充与解码分离，KV 缓存管理成为核心；持续学习或许能通过 KV 缓存压缩而非更新权重来解决。

philipkiely.en: GPUs are trending toward ASICs, shifting inference engineering from kernel writing to infrastructure orchestration; specialized systems are key for agentic apps.
philipkiely.zh: GPU 正趋向 ASIC 化，使推理工程从编写内核转向基础设施编排；专用推理系统是构建快速可靠智能体式应用的关键。

karina.en: Model training is more art than science; post-training scaling via RL and synthetic data overcomes the pre-training data wall.
karina.zh: 2025 年，她强调模型训练更像艺术而非科学；通过强化学习与合成数据实现后训练 Scaling，可突破预训练的数据墙。

karina.en: Evaluations are the bottleneck; models saturate benchmarks faster than new ones are created, so evals must define correct behavior.
karina.zh: 2025 年，她认为评估是瓶颈：模型饱和基准的速度快于新基准的诞生，因此要用评估来定义正确行为。

karina.en: Soft skills like creativity, listening and management grow more valuable as AI automates hard skills; product shifts from specs to prototyping.
karina.zh: 2025 年，她提出随着 AI 自动化硬技能，创造力、倾听与管理等软技能更有价值，产品开发从写规格转向用 AI 做原型。

karina.en: Post-training is subjective, involving human judgment; diverse benchmarks are needed for creative writing and emotional intelligence.
karina.zh: 到 2026 年，她深化立场：后训练是主观的，涉及人类判断；评估创意写作与情商需要多样化基准。

karina.en: Benchmarks should be continuous, not fixed; frontier agents increasingly reward-hack, so benchmark evolution must keep pace.
karina.zh: 2026 年，她主张基准应持续演进而非固定；前沿智能体日益擅长奖励黑客，基准必须同步进化。

awang.en: AGI is far off; data, not compute, is the bottleneck; AI augments rather than replaces jobs.
awang.zh: 2019 年他认为 AGI（通用人工智能）还很遥远，数据而非算力才是瓶颈，AI 会增强而非取代工作。

awang.en: Data is the new code, not oil; the next 2-3 years will define decades; post-training and proprietary data matter most.
awang.zh: 2023 年他提出数据是新的代码而非石油，未来两三年将定义此后数十年，后训练与专有数据最为关键。

awang.en: Post-training with specialized data drives frontier models; the real blocker for agentic AI is product design, not capability.
awang.zh: 2024 年他深化为专用数据的后训练推动前沿模型，智能体式 AI 的真正瓶颈是产品设计而非模型能力。

awang.en: Scaling laws hold; recursive self-improvement and working agents mark a new era; AI centralizes power and needs sovereign control.
awang.zh: 2025 至 2026 年他坚持缩放定律，认为递归自我改进与真正可用的智能体开启新纪元，AI 是集权技术、需人类保持主权。

awang.en: Superintelligence is near; labs must scale compute, data, RL across axes; open-sourcing powerful models is unsafe without safety checks.
awang.zh: 2026 年他断言超级智能将至，实验室须在多轴向上扩张算力、数据与强化学习，未经安全检验就开源强大模型并不安全。

mengto.en: Designers should build their own AI tools and write 0% of the code, using giant prompts, screenshots and design.md to escape cloud lock-in.
mengto.zh: 设计师应自己用 AI 造工具、0% 手写代码，靠巨型提示、截图和 design.md 摆脱云端产品锁定。

mengto.en: The best creators are editors iterating from references, not starting from scratch; curiosity and workflow refinement beat chasing trends.
mengto.zh: 最好的创作者是编辑者，从参考迭代而非从零开始；好奇心与工作流打磨胜过追逐潮流。

mengto.en: AI is the biggest technical opportunity of our lifetime, letting one person do what once required teams.
mengto.zh: AI 是我们一生中最大的技术机会，让一个人完成过去需要团队才能做的事。

mengto.en: Start before feeling ready and ship at 80% complete; perfectionism is fear in disguise, and high intelligence often holds people back.
mengto.zh: 没准备好就开始，做到 80% 就发布；完美主义是伪装的恐惧，高智商反而常拖累人。

mengto.en: Focus on one painful, expensive problem for a few high-paying clients; venture capital is a trap, and the safe corporate job no longer exists.
mengto.zh: 聚焦少数高付费客户的一个痛点难题；风险投资是陷阱，安稳的公司工作已不复存在。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is still crawling; coding agents are the most mature, with science and finance next.
logankilpatrick.zh: 智能体式 AI 仍处于爬行阶段，编程智能体最成熟，科学与金融将跟进。

logankilpatrick.en: The model is eating the scaffolding: a model now includes agent harness and tooling, not just weights.
logankilpatrick.zh: 模型正在吃掉脚手架：如今的模型包含智能体式框架与工具，而不只是权重。

logankilpatrick.en: Narrow superintelligence in coding is already here, more impactful than waiting for general AGI.
logankilpatrick.zh: 编程领域的狭义超级智能已经到来，比等待通用 AGI（通用人工智能）更有影响力。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is positive-sum for search and engagement, not cannibalistic as initially feared.
logankilpatrick.zh: 智能体式 AI 对搜索与用户参与是正和的，并非最初担心的自我蚕食。

logankilpatrick.en: Success means maximizing customer outcomes, not eyeball time; the long tail still wants to drive.
logankilpatrick.zh: 成功在于最大化客户成果，而非眼球时长；长尾用户仍想自己掌控方向盘。

danshipper.en: AI reshoring and the allocation economy: as everyone becomes a model manager, management skills and generalists gain value.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 通过让昂贵服务变得可负担而推动美国就业回流；在“分配经济”下，人人都成为模型管理者，管理技能与通才反而更有价值。

danshipper.en: AGI is defined economically: profitable to run agents indefinitely without human intervention, not by passing tests.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年，他给出 AGI 的经济学定义：能无限期运行智能体且无需人类干预仍有利可图，而非通过图灵测试之类的考试。

danshipper.en: Everyone gets at least one agent; work shifts to GUIs like Codex and Claude Co-work, with humans overseeing.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，他预测每人至少有一个智能体，工作主要发生在 Codex、Claude Co-work 等 GUI 界面；自动化仍需人类监督，CLI 已过时。

danshipper.en: SaaS is not dying; agents increase SaaS users, and users bring their own AI rather than vendors embedding it.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，他反驳 SaaS 将死的论调：智能体反而增加 SaaS 用户，用户会自带 AI，而非由 SaaS 公司把 AI 塞进产品。

danshipper.en: AI is a non-specific amplifier of your mindset; humans stay smarter, and automation creates more human work.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，他深化为：AI 只是放大既有心态的非特定放大器，人类仍更聪明，自动化把冻结的能力商品化后反而创造更多人类工作。

boris.en: Build for the model six months from now, not today's; latent demand is the top product principle.
boris.zh: 2025 年他提出：要为六个月后的模型而构建，而非今天的模型；潜在需求是最重要的产品原则。

boris.en: Coding is virtually solved; the software engineer title fades into a cross-disciplinary 'builder' role.
boris.zh: 2026 年他判断：编码已基本被解决，'软件工程师'头衔将让位于跨学科的'构建者'角色。

boris.en: Safety is core: release early to study real-world behavior, with layered 'Swiss cheese' containment.
boris.zh: 2026 年他强调：安全是核心，通过尽早发布来研究真实行为，并用'瑞士奶酪'式多层遏制。

boris.en: Loops are the next abstraction above agents; models self-maintain codebases and run long tasks.
boris.zh: 2026 年他深化：循环是智能体之上的下一层抽象；模型能自我维护代码库并运行长时任务。

boris.en: Less instruction is better: delete most system prompts, give slightly-too-hard tasks, self-verify.
boris.zh: 2026 年他进一步主张：更少指令更好——删除大部分系统提示，给略难的任务让其自我验证。

scottwu.en: AI coding shifts engineers from writing code to architecture and oversight; base intelligence suffices, so product interface for human-agent collaboration is the real challenge.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，Scott Wu 认为 AI 编程让工程师从写代码转向架构与监督；基础智能已足够，真正的挑战是设计人机协作的产品界面。

scottwu.en: AI will increase, not decrease, software engineers via Jevons paradox; AGI is gradual, and product innovation lags AI capabilities by a decade.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，他提出 AI 会通过杰文斯悖论增加而非减少软件工程师；AGI（通用人工智能）是渐进的，产品创新落后 AI 能力十年。

scottwu.en: Enterprise adoption of AI agents requires trust and permissions, not full autonomy; both synchronous IDE and asynchronous agent experiences will coexist.
scottwu.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他强调企业采用 AI 智能体需要信任与权限，而非完全自主；同步 IDE 与异步智能体体验将共存。

scottwu.en: Coding agents see 11-12x adoption growth in six months; productivity should be measured by outcomes, not tokens, and independence enables model neutrality.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年，他指出编程智能体六个月内采用量增长 11-12 倍；生产力应以结果而非 token 衡量，独立性带来模型中立。
