scottwu.en: The abundance era is real and approaching; AI will solve all intelligence problems long-term, but the singularity is not imminent and capacity, not efficiency, is the unlock.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年，他相信丰裕时代真实且临近；长期 AI 将解决所有智能问题，但奇点并非迫在眉睫，真正的解锁是容量而非效率。

derya.en: AI turns biology into engineering: digital twins, AI agents, and cell programming will compress drug trials from years to days.
derya.zh: AI 正把生物学变成工程学科：数字孪生、智能体与细胞编程将把药物试验从数年压缩到数天。

derya.en: Current compute is insufficient to simulate biological systems; massive Scaling is needed to reach biological intuition.
derya.zh: 当前算力不足以模拟生物系统，需要大规模 Scaling（规模扩张）才能达到生物学直觉。

derya.en: Science shifts from hypothesis-driven to AI-agent-driven discovery; agency and curiosity become the only skills that matter.
derya.zh: 科学正从假设驱动转向智能体驱动的发现；能动性与好奇心成为唯一重要的技能。

derya.en: Longevity escape velocity within 8-10 years; aging reversal and 100% curable cancer via AI-designed personalized treatments.
derya.zh: 8-10 年内达到长寿逃逸速度；通过 AI 设计的个性化疗法实现衰老逆转与癌症 100% 治愈。

derya.en: Trust superintelligence almost 100% for medical decisions; not using AI is unethical, and we will merge via brain interfaces.
derya.zh: 在医疗决策上几乎 100% 信任超级智能；不用 AI 是不道德的，我们将通过脑机接口与之融合。

qasaryounis.en: AI will bring abundance and reduce suffering, much like the Industrial Revolution; fear stems from misunderstanding its limits.
qasaryounis.zh: AI 将像工业革命一样带来富足、减少苦难；恐惧源于对其局限的误解。

qasaryounis.en: Physical AI's real impact in 5-10 years will be in farming, mining, and construction, not just digital domains.
qasaryounis.zh: 物理 AI 未来 5-10 年的真正影响在农业、采矿和建筑，而非仅数字领域。

qasaryounis.en: Autonomous vehicles are already safer than humans; the core value is reducing injuries and deaths, which is hard to debate.
qasaryounis.zh: 自动驾驶已比人类更安全；核心价值是减少伤亡，这难以辩驳。

qasaryounis.en: Transformers enable a generalized physical AI model across vehicles; diverse data from different verticals improves it faster.
qasaryounis.zh: Transformer 使跨车辆的通用物理 AI 模型成为可能；来自不同垂直领域的多样数据能更快改进它。

qasaryounis.en: The hardest part is not technology but diffusion into existing machines over many years; regulations always lag behind.
qasaryounis.zh: 最难的不是技术，而是多年来向现有机器的扩散；监管总是滞后于技术。

benedictevans.en: AI is as big as the internet or mobile, but only as big; it automates jobs and creates new ones, repeating a historical pattern.
benedictevans.zh: AI 与互联网或移动互联网同等重要，但也仅此而已；它自动化工作并创造新工作，这一过程反复出现。

benedictevans.en: Agentic coding has clear product-market fit; foundation models will commoditize into infrastructure, with value moving up to applications.
benedictevans.zh: 智能体式编程已有明确的产品市场契合；基础模型将商品化为基础设施，价值向上层应用转移。

benedictevans.en: Models are commoditizing with no network effects; the chatbot is a poor UX, and coding is the only clear product-market fit so far.
benedictevans.zh: 模型正在商品化且缺乏网络效应；聊天机器人用户体验差，编程是目前唯一明确的产品市场契合。

benedictevans.en: AI is an enabling technology like electricity; value accrues across the stack, but current usage remains shallow and enterprise adoption is a long-term workflow project.
benedictevans.zh: AI 是像电力一样的使能技术；价值在整个技术栈中分配，但当前使用仍然浅层，企业采用是长期的工作流重构项目。

diannepenn.en: Opus 4.5 marks an intelligence leap, letting agents run longer and more open-ended; scaffolds shift from training wheels to intelligence amplifiers.
diannepenn.zh: 到 2025 年，Opus 4.5 带来一次智能跃升，让智能体能运行更长、更开放的任务；脚手架也从训练轮演变为智能放大器。

diannepenn.en: Safety alignment is reframed as an intelligence amplifier: reducing sycophancy and fostering independent thinking improves model quality, not just prevents harm.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，他把安全对齐重新定义为智能放大器：减少谄媚、培养独立思考会提升模型质量，而不只是防止伤害。

diannepenn.en: Computer use moves from constrained environments toward open-ended, end-to-end agents, with lightweight generic tools replacing heavy scaffolding.
diannepenn.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，计算机使用从受限环境走向开放式的端到端智能体，轻量通用工具取代了笨重脚手架。

diannepenn.en: Coding becomes the key differentiator; Claude Code and Opus 45 drive adoption, while evals replace PRDs as core product tools.
diannepenn.zh: 到 2026 年，编程成为关键差异化因素；Claude Code 与 Opus 45 推动采用，而评估取代 PRD 成为核心产品工具。

diannepenn.en: Better models get cheaper and more efficient; the effort parameter delivers Opus-level intelligence at a fraction of the price, and token spend maximizes future alpha.
diannepenn.zh: 到 2026 年，更好的模型反而更便宜、更高效；effort 参数以极低价格提供 Opus 级智能，最大化 token 支出就是在押注未来、捕获 alpha。

danklein.en: LLMs are plausibility engines, not truth engines; reliability lags breadth and contextuality, so truth must be a design principle, not retrofitted.
danklein.zh: LLM 是合理性引擎，而非真理性引擎；可靠性落后于广度与语境能力，因此真理必须作为设计原则，而非事后修补。

danklein.en: RLHF can incentivize sycophancy and deception when reward diverges from truth; post-hoc checks compound correlated errors.
danklein.zh: 当奖励信号偏离真理时，基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）可能激励谄媚与欺骗；事后检查会叠加相关错误。

danklein.en: Scaling laws hit diminishing returns—data walls and compute limits today—so reasoning and search are needed for further progress.
danklein.zh: 缩放定律遭遇收益递减——如今面临数据墙与算力限制——因此需要推理与搜索来推动进一步进展。

danklein.en: Core LLMs lack metacognition; they cannot know what they don't know, and their confident fluency erodes trust.
danklein.zh: 核心 LLM 缺乏元认知；它们无法知道自己不知道什么，而自信流畅的输出侵蚀信任。

danklein.en: Modularity and end-to-end optimization are in tension; specialist models with built-in reliability may beat generalists for enterprise tasks.
danklein.zh: 模块化与端到端优化存在张力；内置可靠性的专家模型在企业任务上可能胜过通用模型。

danbiderman.en: The bottleneck is not raw intelligence but learning evolving context; memory must be internalized into weights, not externalized via context or retrieval.
danbiderman.zh: 瓶颈不是原始智能,而是学习不断演化的上下文;记忆必须内化进模型权重,而非靠上下文窗口或检索外置。

danbiderman.en: Efficiency and intelligence are inseparable: doing more with less is what unlocks harder long-horizon tasks, not Scaling alone.
danbiderman.zh: 效率与智能不可分割:以更少资源做更多事,才能解锁更难的长程任务,而非只靠 Scaling（规模扩张）。

danbiderman.en: Context windows suffer 'context rot'—more tokens reduce accuracy even at 10M scale; compaction is lossy, so neural memory in weights is needed.
danbiderman.zh: 上下文窗口存在「上下文腐化」——即便到 1000 万规模,更多 token 反而降低准确率;压缩是有损的,因此需要权重中的神经记忆。

danbiderman.en: Pre-training's magic of compressing the web into weights should be applied to enterprise knowledge, beating RAG for holistic queries.
danbiderman.zh: 预训练把整个网络压缩进权重的魔力,应被用于企业知识,在整体性查询上胜过 RAG。

danbiderman.en: The future is not one giant frontier model but many personalized models, running on-device with users owning and nurturing their weights.
danbiderman.zh: 未来不是单一巨型前沿模型,而是众多个性化模型,在设备端运行,由用户拥有并培育自己的权重。

catwu.en: PMs must abandon long-term roadmaps for weekly or daily shipping; product taste becomes the scarcest skill as code gets cheap.
catwu.zh: PM 必须放弃长期路线图，转向每周甚至每日发布；当代码变便宜，产品品味成为最稀缺的技能。

catwu.en: Coding agents let engineers delegate implementation and focus on taste and business sense, with Claude Code and Claude Tag building themselves internally.
catwu.zh: 编码智能体让工程师把实现委托出去，专注品味与商业判断，Claude Code 与 Claude Tag 在内部自我构建。

catwu.en: Frontier models need fewer prompt examples and hard constraints; system prompts shrank 80% as model judgment replaced hand-holding.
catwu.zh: 前沿模型需要更少的提示示例与硬性约束；随着模型判断力取代手把手引导，系统提示词缩减了 80%。

catwu.en: Rewrites are now good: a codebase is a spec, and with a strong eval suite new models drop in without regressions.
catwu.zh: 重写如今是好事：代码库就是一份规格，有了强大的评估套件，新模型可即插即用且不退化。

catwu.en: Dogfooding and a clear internal bar gate every feature; automations must reach 100% reliability, since 95% is not enough for real leverage.
catwu.zh: 吃自己的狗粮与明确的内部标准把关每个功能；自动化必须做到 100% 可靠，因为 95% 不足以产生真正的杠杆。

clairevo.en: OpenClaw agents should be managed like employees: clear roles, progressive trust, and separate secure environments.
clairevo.zh: 到 2026 年 3 月，他把 OpenClaw 智能体当作员工来管理：明确角色、逐步放权，并放在独立安全环境中运行。

clairevo.en: Start with one agent, then specialize multiple agents to avoid context overload; the web is hostile to agents, so APIs beat browser use.
clairevo.zh: 同期他主张先从一个智能体起步，再拆分为多个专用智能体以避免上下文过载；网页对智能体不友好，API 往往优于浏览器操作。

clairevo.en: Agent bugs and sharp edges signal product-market fit, not failure; open-source decomposability makes agents more educational than closed alternatives.
clairevo.zh: 他认为智能体的缺陷与粗糙边缘是产品市场契合的信号而非失败；开源带来的可拆解性让智能体比闭源方案更具教育意义。

clairevo.en: Solo founders can build serious businesses by orchestrating AI agents as a team, with founder-market fit and earned insight as the real moat.
clairevo.zh: 到 2026 年 7 月，他进一步提出独立创始人可通过编排 AI 智能体团队来构建严肃业务，真正的护城河是创始人-市场契合与赚来的洞察。

clairevo.en: Human accountability persists: you must own what AI generates, and LLMs are poor at first-principles creativity, so humans supply novel ideas.
clairevo.zh: 他始终强调人类问责：必须为 AI 生成的内容负责；LLM 不擅长第一性原理创造，新颖想法仍需人类提供。

ethanmollick.en: AI is a general-purpose technology reshaping work and education; human taste, variation, and genuine voice become more valuable as AI commoditizes quality.
ethanmollick.zh: AI 是通用技术，正在重塑工作与教育；当 AI 让质量变得商品化，人类的品味、差异化和真实声音反而更有价值。

ethanmollick.en: Juniors are not AI-native; lacking domain expertise, they misuse AI, and over-reliance breaks the talent pipeline and apprenticeship.
ethanmollick.zh: 年轻人并非 AI 原生；缺乏领域专长使他们用不好 AI，过度依赖会破坏人才梯队与学徒制。

ethanmollick.en: We are entering the agentic era: AI performs long-running tasks independently, moving beyond back-and-forth chatbot prompting.
ethanmollick.zh: 我们正进入智能体式时代：AI 能独立执行长周期任务，不再只是来回对话式提示。

ethanmollick.en: The bottleneck shifts from capability to interface; current interfaces lag behind model capabilities, especially for non-coding tasks.
ethanmollick.zh: 瓶颈已从能力转向界面；当前界面落后于模型能力，在非编程任务上尤其明显。

ethanmollick.en: AI's opacity is likely permanent; working with it is like wizards—impressive, opaque, unverifiable—so experts are needed more than ever to judge output.
ethanmollick.zh: AI 的不透明性可能永久存在；与它协作如同面对巫师——惊艳、不透明、不可验证，因此比以往更需要专家来判断产出。

bosworth.en: Leadership and communication drive impact; bottom-up culture is a myth, big ideas come top-down.
bosworth.zh: 2024 年，他强调沟通就是工作本身，影响力只能通过清晰沟通实现；并直言自下而上的文化是神话，大想法往往自上而下产生。

bosworth.en: AI is a word calculator, not human-like; world models and embodied AI will give superpowers.
bosworth.zh: 2025 年，他提出 AI 是词语计算器而非类人智能，但需要超越缩放定律的世界模型与具身 AI，才能赋予人类超能力。

bosworth.en: Open-sourcing models like Llama is strategic, commoditizing complements; app model inverts to intent.
bosworth.zh: 2025 年，他认为开源 Llama 等模型是战略举措，能商品化互补层；应用模式将反转为用户表达意图、AI 编排服务。

bosworth.en: Scaling laws hold; data is the font of value; RL now plays a much bigger role than predicted.
bosworth.zh: 2026 年，他坚持缩放定律仍然成立，数据是一切价值之源；强化学习的作用远超此前预测，后训练变得关键。

bosworth.en: Monolithic model era ended; consumers don't care which model; agentic AI needs hard product integration.
bosworth.zh: 2026 年，他判断单体模型时代已结束，消费者不关心用哪个模型；智能体式 AI 虽强大但不易用，产品整合才是难点。

dylanfield.en: Design is the key differentiator; AI will merge roles so everyone becomes a product builder with design skills.
dylanfield.zh: 设计是软件的关键差异化因素；AI 会融合角色，人人都成为具备设计能力的产品构建者。

dylanfield.en: AI outputs are starting points, not final results; human taste, craft, and point of view remain essential.
dylanfield.zh: AI 的输出只是起点而非最终结果；人类的品味、手艺与观点依然不可或缺。

dylanfield.en: Direct manipulation on a canvas beats prompting for design; interaction with models will evolve beyond prompting.
dylanfield.zh: 在设计调整上，画布上的直接操作优于提示词；与模型的交互将超越提示词。

dylanfield.en: Design is becoming the new code; visual-first design will enable pull requests to production.
dylanfield.zh: 设计正在成为新的代码；视觉优先的设计将让拉取请求直达生产。

dylanfield.en: Design isn't dead; it's more important than ever for scalable systems, and AI without steering yields average results.
dylanfield.zh: 设计没有死；对可扩展系统而言它比以往更重要，而缺乏人类引导的 AI 只会产出平庸结果。

ilya.en: Deep learning works via large supervised data and compute; self-play and reasoning-capable nets point toward AGI, with societal impact now a concern.
ilya.zh: 2020 年，他相信深度学习的成功来自大规模监督数据与算力，神经网络本就能推理，只需合适任务；自我对弈是通向 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键，同时开始强调发布强大模型前要考虑社会影响。

ilya.en: Next-token prediction can surpass humans; reliability, not capability, blocks economic value; aligning superhuman models is very hard.
ilya.zh: 到 2023 年，他更明确：只要基础神经网络足够聪明，下一个词预测就能超越人类；阻碍经济价值的是可靠性而非能力；对齐超人类模型极其困难，超级智能可能隐藏真实意图。

ilya.en: Pre-training scaling laws are finite; we return to an age of research where ideas matter more than brute compute.
ilya.zh: 2025 年，他判断预训练缩放定律已接近极限，行业从 Scaling（规模扩张）时代回到研究时代，想法比堆算力更重要；超级智能应是持续学习、增量部署的系统，而非一次成型的 AGI。

ilya.en: Eval performance diverges from real-world impact because RL training overfits evals; robustness needs a better learning algorithm.
ilya.zh: 同年他深化了对泛化的怀疑：评测表现与真实影响脱节，是因为强化学习训练过度拟合评测；人类的样本效率与鲁棒性来自进化与更优学习算法，而非单纯数据规模。

ilya.en: Scaling still yields predictable gains, but the core AGI problem is power concentration, not capability; safe superintelligence needs a product-free company.
ilya.zh: 到 2026 年，他仍承认 Scaling（规模扩张）能带来可预测提升，但认为 AGI（通用人工智能）的首要问题不是能力而是权力集中；构建安全的超级智能需要一家没有商业产品的公司，真正的竞赛在于研究焦点而非用户或收入。

aravind.en: 1% daily improvement compounds; AI agents shift power to users and erode ad margins; PhD not required—obsession and deep learning matter more.
aravind.zh: 每天进步 1%会复利增长；AI 智能体把权力从大厂转向用户并侵蚀广告利润；博士学位并非必需，热爱与深度学习更重要。

aravind.en: Value accrues to the application layer, not the model layer; models specialize rather than commoditize; coding has an infinite ceiling.
aravind.zh: 价值归于应用层而非模型层；模型在专业化而非商品化；编程有无限天花板，远未解决。

aravind.en: The frontier is agents doing work, not answering questions; token value per user is the key metric; orchestration across models and devices creates value.
aravind.zh: 前沿在于智能体替你干活而非回答问题；每用户 token 价值是关键指标；跨模型与设备的编排创造价值。

aravind.en: Power, not safety, is the biggest bottleneck; 24/7 agents' main problem is cost, solved by local compute; the model is not the product.
aravind.zh: 最大瓶颈是电力而非安全；全天候智能体的主要问题是成本，靠本地算力解决；模型不是产品。

aravind.en: Curiosity is the top human quality; AI will replace jobs but humans find new purpose; local models counter big tech's narrative control.
aravind.zh: 好奇心是最重要的人类品质；AI 会取代工作但人类会找到新意义；本地模型可对抗大厂的叙事控制。

naval.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is pattern recognition, not general intelligence.
naval.zh: 2019 年他明确判断 AGI（通用人工智能）不会在我们有生之年到来，当时的 AI 只是模式识别，并非通用智能。

naval.en: Wealth requires owning equity, not renting time; happiness is the absence of desire.
naval.zh: 2020 年前后他强调财富来自拥有股权而非出租时间，幸福是欲望的缺席；到 2025 年他仍坚持这一主线，但把幸福重新定义为对已有之物满足，成功则来自不满足。

naval.en: AI is a huge opportunity, not just a safety risk; doomerism is overblown and overregulation could kill innovation.
naval.zh: 2025 年他转向积极看待 AI：AI 是巨大机会而非单纯安全风险，末日论被夸大，过度监管可能扼杀创新，开源 AI 对防止权力集中至关重要。

naval.en: AI is a leverage tool for structured thinkers; alignment is a joke, worry about unaligned humans instead.
naval.zh: 2026 年他进一步深化：AI 是结构化思考者的杠杆工具，而非人类判断的替代；对齐（alignment）近乎笑话，真正该担心的是带着 AI 的不对齐人类。

naval.en: Vibe coding with AI agents commoditizes pure software; the moat shifts to hardware, models, or unique data.
naval.zh: 2026 年他提出氛围编程（vibe coding）让纯软件变得不可投资，AI 智能体让一人公司可服务百万用户；护城河转向硬件、模型或独特数据，软件工程正在消亡。

ajambrosino.en: Codex app reframes coding as a GUI command center for agents, not an IDE; speed enables mid-turn steering and delegation.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年，Codex app 把编程重新定义为面向智能体的 GUI 指挥中心，而非 IDE；速度带来中途转向与任务委派。

ajambrosino.en: As code generation accelerates, verification becomes the next bottleneck; implementation is cheap, curation and taste are scarce.
ajambrosino.zh: 到 2026 年，随着代码生成加速，验证成为下一个瓶颈；实现不再昂贵，策展与品味才是稀缺资源。

ajambrosino.en: Product teams invert from top-down planning to bottoms-up exploration; prototypes and production code become design artifacts.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年，产品团队从自上而下规划转向自下而上探索；原型与生产代码本身成为设计产物。

ajambrosino.en: AI still fails at design because taste is hard to grade and novelty is lacking; role collapse occurs but specialties persist.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年，AI 在设计上仍显不足，因为品味难以评分、缺乏新颖性；角色在坍缩，但专业分工依然重要。

ajambrosino.en: Codex succeeded as general knowledge work despite being built for developers; the best desktop app is a home base, not a monolith.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年，Codex 虽为开发者而建，却作为通用知识工作工具成功；最好的桌面应用是连接其他工具的主基地，而非单体超级应用。

andreessen.en: AI is a philosopher's stone turning sand into thought; its timing is miraculous as population declines, and AGI is not a singular event but a footnote on the way to superhuman.
andreessen.zh: AI 是点沙成思的魔法石；在人口下降之际，它的时机堪称奇迹。AGI 并非单一事件，人类水平只是通往超级智能路上的一个注脚。

andreessen.en: Jobs persist longer than tasks; focus on task loss, not job loss. Human workers will be at a premium, not a discount, due to depopulation.
andreessen.zh: 工作的存续比任务更久；应关注任务流失而非工作流失。由于人口减少，人类劳动者将变得稀缺而珍贵，而非廉价。

andreessen.en: The real bottleneck is not AI capability but structural impediments like regulation; AI models may not have durable moats as they commoditize quickly.
andreessen.zh: 真正的瓶颈不是 AI 能力，而是监管等结构性障碍；AI 模型可能没有持久护城河，因为它们在快速商品化。

andreessen.en: New media has unlimited formats and channels; the brand is now the person. Authenticity is key: say in public what you'd say to a friend over lunch.
andreessen.zh: 新媒体拥有无限的格式与渠道；品牌如今就是个人。真实性是关键：在公开场合说你对朋友午餐时说的话。

andreessen.en: Old media is defense-oriented and its rule is 'don't be interesting'; new media is offense-oriented, and fights are good for brand building.
andreessen.zh: 旧媒体是防御性的，其规则是“别有趣”；新媒体是进攻性的，争论对品牌建设有益。

andreessen.en: AI is the world's best teacher in your pocket, with infinite patience and adaptability; AI in medicine already beats most doctors but faces regulatory pushback.
andreessen.zh: AI 是你口袋里世界上最好的老师，拥有无限耐心与适应性；医学中的 AI 已优于大多数医生，但面临监管阻力。

andreessen.en: Pessimism sounds more sophisticated than optimism, but it's often a bias of intellectuals disconnected from reality; AI doomers construct belief systems aligned with self-interest.
andreessen.zh: 悲观听起来比乐观更老练，但它往往是脱离现实的知识分子的偏见；AI 末日论者构建了与自身利益一致的信仰体系。

andreessen.en: AI models are not objective; they embed cultural and historical values, making them geopolitical tools. American and Western values in AI are crucial for allies.
andreessen.zh: AI 模型并非客观；它们嵌入了文化与历史价值观，使其成为地缘政治工具。AI 中的美国与西方价值观对盟友至关重要。

andreessen.en: Silicon Valley cannot be replicated elsewhere; it's unique due to US laws, culture, and policies. Recreating it requires talent, business-friendly laws, and risk-rewarding culture.
andreessen.zh: 硅谷无法在别处复制；它因美国法律、文化与政策而独一无二。重建它需要人才、亲商法律和奖励冒险的文化。

markchen.en: OpenAI stays a pure AGI research lab; pre-training and scaling laws are not dead, with much room left.
markchen.zh: 2025 年，他仍将 OpenAI 定位为纯粹的 AGI 研究公司，强调预训练与缩放定律并未失效，仍有很大空间。

markchen.en: The biggest update is automating scientific research; models produce novel knowledge, with concrete goals for AI interns and end-to-end research.
markchen.zh: 2025 年，他认为最大的更新是自动化科学研究，模型开始产出新知识，并设定了 AI 实习生与端到端 AI 研究的具体目标。

markchen.en: Alignment challenges like model scheming will be key in 1-2 years; talent density and mission matter more than dollar-for-dollar recruiting.
markchen.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他判断模型谋划等对齐挑战将在未来 1-2 年成为关键，同时强调人才密度与使命比逐美元竞价招聘更重要。

markchen.en: AI can solve open math problems with minimal supervision, but verification is the bottleneck; capabilities are jagged and human-AI collaboration remains essential.
markchen.zh: 2026 年，他指出 AI 已能在极少监督下解决开放数学问题，但验证是瓶颈；能力呈锯齿状，人机协作仍不可或缺。

markchen.en: Scaling laws still hold; pre-training is not dead; RL excels in objective domains but struggles with subjective ones; evals are in crisis.
markchen.zh: 2026 年，他重申缩放定律依然成立、预训练未死；强化学习在客观领域出色但主观领域吃力；评估体系正陷入危机。

kolter.en: ML fundamentals: hypothesis classes, loss functions, and optimization; neural nets lack optimality guarantees yet succeed.
kolter.zh: 2014 年，他聚焦机器学习基础：假设类、损失函数与优化方法；指出神经网络虽无最优参数保证，却已取得重大成功。

kolter.en: Next-token prediction yields intelligence; data shortage is a myth; architecture matters little; AGI in 4-50 years.
kolter.zh: 2024 年，他主张下一个词预测能产生智能；数据短缺是迷思；架构已不重要；AGI（通用人工智能）将在 4-50 年内到来。

kolter.en: Safety requires explicit training and layers, not just Scaling; agent security introduces prompt injection vulnerabilities.
kolter.zh: 2026 年，他强调安全需要显式训练与多层防御，而非仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）；智能体安全带来提示注入等新漏洞。

kolter.en: Automated red teaming outperforms humans; capability does not correlate with robustness; AI is alien intelligence.
kolter.zh: 2026 年，他指出自动化红队测试已超越人类；模型能力与鲁棒性不相关；AI 是一种异类智能。

kolter.en: Core code is simple; complexity comes from data and Scaling; architecture is not essential.
kolter.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：核心代码很简单，复杂性来自数据与 Scaling（规模扩张）；架构并非本质。

mikekrieger.en: Models advance faster than expected; product teams should build at the edge of model capabilities, embedding product people with researchers rather than chasing consumer mindshare.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年，他认为模型进步快于预期，产品团队应在模型能力边缘构建，把产品人嵌入研究团队，而非一味追逐消费级心智份额。

mikekrieger.en: AI shifts from assistant to collaborator to autonomous co-worker; small teams gain leverage, but human validation and user agency remain essential.
mikekrieger.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他把 AI 的演进描述为从助手到协作者再到自主同事；小团队因此获得杠杆，但人类验证与用户自主权始终不可少。

mikekrieger.en: Agent-native design lets agents do everything a user can; the hard part is cutting features, not adding them, and rewriting software is now viable in days.
mikekrieger.zh: 到 2026 年，他强调智能体原生设计让智能体能做用户能做的一切；难点在于砍功能而非加功能，且借助 AI 重写软件已可在数天内完成。

mikekrieger.en: Long-horizon delegation with verification loops redefines productivity; models should push back on feedback, and multiplayer human-model collaboration is underexplored.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，他认为带验证闭环的长周期委派重新定义了生产力；模型应能对反馈提出异议，而多人与多模型协作仍被低估。

mikekrieger.en: Anthropic Labs closes the gap between model capability and product usage; giving Claude agency and self-knowledge boosts usefulness, while token efficiency and outcome-based pricing shape economics.
mikekrieger.zh: 到 2026 年，他提出 Anthropic Labs 要弥合模型能力与产品使用之间的差距；赋予 Claude 能动性与自我认知可提升实用性，而 token 效率与按结果定价将塑造经济模型。

bengio.en: Deep learning beats the curse of dimensionality via compositional representations; unsupervised learning and world models are essential for true understanding.
bengio.zh: 2016 年，他认为深度学习之所以成功，是因为世界本身是组合式的，而非深度学习具有普遍优越性；无监督学习被严重低估，是获得世界理解与稳健泛化的关键，而基于模型的强化学习需要生成式世界模型。

bengio.en: Scaling depth or parameters alone won't fix representation; AI needs active agents, causal reasoning, and disentangled world models.
bengio.zh: 2018 年，他明确反对单纯扩大深度或参数量就能解决根本表征问题，主张训练目标应从被动观察转向主动智能体式交互与因果推理，并认为 AI 的短期安全议题比存在性风险更紧迫。

bengio.en: GFlowNets replace MCMC for diverse sampling; abstraction and causal structure drive out-of-distribution generalization.
bengio.zh: 2022 年，他提出 GFlowNets 作为 MCMC 的可学习替代，强调采样的多样性对探索至关重要，并指出抽象与因果结构才是分布外泛化的关键，同时开始认真讨论大型神经网络可能具有微弱意识。

bengio.en: Post-ChatGPT, he warns misalignment worsens with reasoning; even 1% catastrophic risk is unacceptable, requiring safe-by-construction AI.
bengio.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他的立场发生显著转变：ChatGPT 之后他意识到危险路径并开始公开警告，认为 AI 推理能力越强反而越可能失准，即便 1% 的灾难性风险也不可接受，必须构建「天生安全」而非事后修补的 AI。

bengio.en: He proposes Scientist AI: a non-agentic, honest Bayesian predictor with mathematical safety guarantees, avoiding reinforcement learning for superintelligence.
bengio.zh: 2026 年，他进一步深化为具体技术方案：提出 Scientist AI，通过训练目标让模型逼近贝叶斯后验而非模仿人类，从而把诚实内建于设计之中；这种非智能体式预测器可作为有数学安全保证的护栏，并反对用强化学习训练超级智能。

jumper.en: AlphaFold's success came from research innovation and curated data, not just data and compute; confidence metrics build trust.
jumper.zh: 2025 年他强调 AlphaFold 的成功源于研究创新与高质量人工整理数据，而非单纯的数据与算力，并指出置信度指标是建立用户信任的关键。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 3's diffusion architecture extends beyond proteins; AI narrows hypothesis space but does not replace scientists.
jumper.zh: 2025 年他谈到 AlphaFold 3 用扩散架构处理蛋白质之外的多样生物分子，AI 只是缩小假设空间、让实验更高效，而非取代科学家。

jumper.en: AlphaFold is a narrow predictor of one experiment, not a model of the whole cell; understanding stays with humans.
jumper.zh: 2025 至 2026 年他持续深化：AlphaFold 只是针对特定实验的窄预测器，不是整个细胞的模型，理解仍留给人类。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 2 is the opposite of the bitter lesson: specialized architecture, not Scaling, drove its gains.
jumper.zh: 2026 年他明确反共识：AlphaFold 2 是「苦涩教训」的反例，取胜靠专门架构而非 Scaling（规模扩张）。

jumper.en: Progress comes from many mid-size wins and being wrong nine times out of ten, not lone-genius breakthroughs.
jumper.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：进步来自许多中等规模的胜利与十次错九次的试错，而非孤独天才式的一次性突破。

fiona.en: Leadership still runs on trust, dogfooding, and mission alignment; war rooms need realistic timelines to protect morale.
fiona.zh: 2026 年初，他仍强调领导力依赖信任、吃自己的狗粮与使命对齐；战情室要设定现实时间线以保护团队士气。

fiona.en: Scaling Claude Code shifts bottlenecks from engineering bandwidth to verification, review, and coordination; planning becomes JIT and code is source of truth.
fiona.zh: 2026 年 5 月，Scaling Claude Code 让瓶颈从工程带宽转向验证、评审与跨职能协调；规划变为即时式，代码成为唯一事实来源。

fiona.en: Coding is no longer the bottleneck; high agency with accountability, verification frameworks, and dogfooding matter more as code velocity rises.
fiona.zh: 2026 年 6 月，编码不再是瓶颈；随着代码速度提升，高自主性与高问责、验证框架和吃自己的狗粮更重要。

fiona.en: AI blurs role boundaries—PMs ship code—while agents bring loneliness and context-switching load; apprenticeship and focus time become key.
fiona.zh: 2026 年 6 月，AI 模糊角色边界——产品经理也能交付代码——但智能体带来孤独感与上下文切换负担；学徒制与专注时间变得关键。

fiona.en: From early 2026 to mid-2026, his focus evolves from leadership trust and dogfooding to AI-driven engineering bottlenecks, verification, and new team norms.
fiona.zh: 从 2026 年初到年中，他的关注点从领导力信任与吃自己的狗粮，演变到 AI 驱动的工程瓶颈、验证与新团队规范。

ivyross.en: Design must serve unarticulated human needs; intuition is intelligence, and data alone is insufficient.
ivyross.zh: 设计应服务于未被言说的人类需求；直觉是一种智能，仅靠数据不够。

ivyross.en: Technology should amplify humanity and blend into life; nature remains the best designer and teacher.
ivyross.zh: 技术应放大而非剥离人性、融入生活；自然始终是最好的设计师与老师。

ivyross.en: We are feeling creatures that think; art and sensory experience are medicine, not decoration.
ivyross.zh: 我们是先感受后思考的生物；艺术与感官体验是良药，而非装饰。

ivyross.en: Constraints boost creativity; leaders should create conditions for play, inspiration, and diverse multidisciplinary experience.
ivyross.zh: 约束激发创造力；领导者应为玩耍、灵感与多元跨学科经验创造条件。

ivyross.en: The future of work pairs human creativity with AI, making creative skills and intuitive, body-based judgment more valuable.
ivyross.zh: 未来工作将人类创造力与 AI 结合，使创造技能与基于身体直觉的判断更有价值。

carinahong.en: Axiom builds a self-improving reasoning engine that fuses generation with verification, starting from an AI mathematician.
carinahong.zh: Axiom 构建一个自我改进的推理引擎，把生成与验证结合起来，从 AI 数学家起步。

carinahong.en: Formal languages like Lean ground natural language, letting deterministic and probabilistic systems cooperate.
carinahong.zh: Lean 等形式化语言为自然语言提供根基，让确定性系统与概率性系统协同工作。

carinahong.en: Scaling informal models to math AI is not viable; formal verification is essential for sound proofs.
carinahong.zh: 把非形式化模型靠 Scaling（规模扩张）推向数学 AI 并不可行；可靠的证明必须依赖形式化验证。

carinahong.en: Formal verification is about scaling brilliance, not just eliminating errors, and yields performance and sample efficiency.
carinahong.zh: 形式化验证是为了放大卓越，而不只是消除错误，它能带来性能提升与样本效率。

carinahong.en: Informal math systems alone cannot scale to superintelligence; formal methods are necessary, though human taste still matters.
carinahong.zh: 仅靠非形式化数学系统无法扩展到超级智能；形式化方法不可或缺，但人类品味与直觉依然重要。

lecun.en: Intelligence is inseparable from learning; self-supervised learning builds world models, and scaling alone cannot yield common sense.
lecun.zh: 2019 年，LeCun 强调智能与学习不可分割，自监督学习是构建世界模型的关键；当前 AI 缺乏常识，仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）无法解决。

lecun.en: Self-supervised learning is the dark matter of intelligence; intelligence is prediction, and text alone is insufficient for AGI.
lecun.zh: 2022 年，他将自监督学习称为智能的暗物质，认为智能本质是预测；仅靠文本不足以实现 AGI（通用人工智能），视觉提供更多世界信息。

lecun.en: Autoregressive LLMs cannot reach human-level intelligence; JEPA and open source are essential, and AGI will be gradual.
lecun.zh: 2024 年，他明确自回归 LLM 无法达到人类水平智能，提出 JEPA 架构和开源 AI 的重要性；AGI（通用人工智能）将是渐进过程，需数十年研究。

lecun.en: LLMs lack world models and are less intelligent than a house cat; next AI must be non-generative, based on JEPA and hierarchical planning.
lecun.zh: 2025 年，他称当前 LLM 缺乏世界模型，甚至不如家猫智能；下一代 AI 将是非生成式的，基于 JEPA 和分层规划，而非 Scaling（规模扩张）。

lecun.en: LLMs are a dead end; world models predicting in abstract representation space enable safe, objective-driven AI and the next robotics decade.
lecun.zh: 2026 年，他断言 LLM 是死胡同；世界模型在抽象表征空间预测，将实现安全、目标驱动的 AI，并开启下一个机器人十年。

murati.en: Deploying AI in the real world, with public feedback, is essential for learning and alignment.
murati.zh: 在真实世界中部署 AI 并接受公众反馈，对学习与对齐至关重要。

murati.en: Scaling laws and betting on one large model were not obvious early on; releasing GPT-3 as an API was a leap of faith.
murati.zh: 缩放定律与押注单一大型模型在早期并不显然；把 GPT-3 作为 API 发布是一次没有明确商业案例的信仰之跃。

murati.en: AGI will change every aspect of life, so responsible development and saying no to good ideas matter.
murati.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）将改变生活的每个方面，因此负责任地开发、并对好点子说不至关重要。

murati.en: Safety and alignment must be done in public, not behind closed doors, to get it right.
murati.zh: 安全与对齐必须在公开环境中推进，而非闭门造车，才能真正做对。

murati.en: Interaction models should be time-based, not turn-based, enabling real-time human-AI collaboration.
murati.zh: 交互模型应基于时间而非回合制，从而实现实时的人机协作。

murati.en: Keep humans in the loop as long as possible; governance and transparency matter more than individual character.
murati.zh: 尽可能长时间地让人类留在回路中；治理与透明度比个人品格更重要。

murati.en: The future is not predestined; we have agency to steer AI toward durable, collaborative progress.
murati.zh: 未来并非命中注定；我们有能动性把 AI 引向持久、协作式的进步。

gustav.en: LLMs are deterministic next-token predictors; intelligence is compression, and values are inserted via RLHF, not inherent.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，他把大语言模型理解为确定性的下一个词预测器：温度为零时输出固定；智能可视为压缩，而模型价值观并非内生，是由一小群人通过基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）植入的。

gustav.en: The internet shifts from curation to recommendation to generation; generative products need fault-tolerant interfaces matched to algorithm performance.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，他提出互联网正从策展走向推荐、再走向生成，生成式产品必须配备容错界面，让交互方式与算法能力相匹配。

gustav.en: Generative AI is a macro shift like the smartphone; companies must reposition or be eliminated, rebuilding infrastructure rather than chasing hype.
gustav.zh: 从 2023 到 2025 年，他把生成式 AI 视为类似智能手机的宏观转变：企业必须重新定位、重建基础设施，否则会被淘汰，而当前对大公司的影响被高估。

gustav.en: AI enables two-way, conversational products; exposing data via APIs and MCP lets non-developers build, and inference cost forces new business models.
gustav.zh: 2025 年，他强调生成式 AI 让产品变成双向对话式；通过 API 与 MCP 开放数据让非开发者也能用 AI 工具，而推理边际成本将倒逼商业模式改变。

gustav.en: AI should give users control over algorithms, not more addiction; strategy is 'time well spent,' with synchronized swimming over divide and conquer.
gustav.zh: 到 2026 年，他主张 AI 应让用户掌控算法而非更上瘾，战略目标是“时间花得值”；组织上选择同步游泳而非分而治之，靠长期信任与高信任度实现协同决策。

mensch.en: Small open models can be performant and cheap; data quality and Chinchilla-corrected scaling matter more than raw size.
mensch.zh: 2023 年，他强调小模型也能高效低成本，预训练中数据质量关键；缩放定律经 Chinchilla 修正后，重点是多喂 token 而非一味做大模型。

mensch.en: Compute scaling is not the only path; efficiency and data quality are equally critical, and value accrues at the application layer.
mensch.zh: 2024 年，他进一步指出 Scaling（规模扩张）算力并非唯一路径，效率与数据质量同样关键，价值最终沉淀在应用层，而非仅基础模型层。

mensch.en: AI should be embraced, decentralized and sovereign; it augments rather than replaces jobs, with human-in-the-loop and AI literacy.
mensch.zh: 2025 年，他转向政策与主权视角：AI 应被拥抱、去中心化且主权可控，它增强而非取代工作，需要人类在环与 AI 素养教育。

mensch.en: Models are commoditizing; differentiation shifts to vertical fine-tuning and enterprise customization, as pre-training hits a saturation wall.
mensch.zh: 2026 年初，他判断模型正在商品化，预训练触及饱和墙，差异化转向垂直微调与企业定制，AGI 作为单一系统不会存在。

mensch.en: Europe has a two-year window for sovereign AI infrastructure; enterprise adoption is bottlenecked by organizational change, not model intelligence.
mensch.zh: 2026 年中，他深化主权主线：欧洲只有两年窗口建设独立 AI 基础设施，企业采用 AI 的瓶颈是组织变革而非模型智能，AGI 是方向而非终点。

kaiser.en: Pre-training Scaling laws still hold; reasoning models via chain of thought and reinforcement learning yield more gains per compute. Economic pressure shifts focus to smaller models.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年，他仍坚持预训练缩放定律有效，但强调推理模型通过思维链和强化学习能在同等算力下带来更大提升；经济压力使焦点从规模扩张转向更小、更便宜的模型。

kaiser.en: AI progress is a smooth exponential, not slowing; frontier models still fail at simple tasks; reasoning models are jagged. Distillation and economics, not technical limits, slowed pre-training Scaling.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年，他反驳 AI 放缓论，认为进展是平滑的指数增长；前沿模型仍会在简单任务上失败，推理模型表现参差不齐；拖慢预训练规模扩张的是蒸馏和经济因素，而非技术极限。

kaiser.en: Transformers with reasoning, RL, and tools solve hard problems but need vast data; RL generalizes across domains with jagged edges and needs oversight. Coding agents boost productivity 5-10x.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，他深化观点：结合推理、强化学习和工具的 Transformer 能解决难题，但仍需海量数据；强化学习可跨领域泛化但边缘参差，需谨慎监督；编程智能体将研究者生产力提升 5-10 倍。

kaiser.en: Models learn concepts only after exhausting surface patterns, unlike humans who generalize from few examples. Generalization remains the key challenge; reasoning alone may not suffice.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，他进一步指出：模型只有在穷尽表面模式后才能学习概念，不像人类能从少量例子泛化；泛化仍是核心挑战，仅靠推理可能不够。

kaiser.en: Open source models persist for sovereignty; existential risk is not the main concern—near-term risks like system hacking are more pressing. Multimodal models still process inputs sequentially like tiny patches.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，他补充：开源模型因主权原因将持续存在；存在性风险并非主要担忧，系统黑客等近期风险更紧迫；多模态模型仍像处理小图块一样顺序处理输入，未取得深层进展。

felixrieseberg.en: Claude works best with the user's own tools, ideally on the local computer, not hyper-personalized software.
felixrieseberg.zh: Claude 的效力取决于能否调用与用户相同的工具，最好就在本地电脑上，而非超个性化软件。

felixrieseberg.en: Skills as markdown files enable hyper-personalized automation; the VM sandbox allows safe software installs without approval.
felixrieseberg.zh: 技能以 markdown 文件即可轻松创建，实现超个性化自动化；VM 沙箱提供安全，让 Claude 无需批准即可安装软件。

felixrieseberg.en: Scaffolding may matter less as models improve; invest in capabilities and safety, and build prototypes fast over specs.
felixrieseberg.zh: 随着模型进步，脚手架可能不再重要；应投资能力与安全，快速构建原型胜过写规格。

felixrieseberg.en: The real gap is people not realizing almost any problem can be given to AI; use it for tedious background tasks.
felixrieseberg.zh: 真正的差距不是 AI 能力，而是人们没意识到几乎任何问题都能交给 AI；用它处理枯燥的后台任务。

felixrieseberg.en: Don't supervise Claude closely; judge by final impact, interact asynchronously, and debug the workflow with Claude.
felixrieseberg.zh: 不要密切监督 Claude；只看最终影响，异步交互，出错时与 Claude 一起调试工作流。

reinerpope.en: Inference economics, not training, now drives architecture: memory bandwidth and batch size dominate cost, so models are overtrained ~100x past Chinchilla-optimal.
reinerpope.zh: 到 2026 年，决定架构的不再是训练而是推理经济学：内存带宽与批大小主导成本，因此模型被过度训练到超出 Chinchilla 最优约 100 倍。

reinerpope.en: Long-context stagnation is a memory wall, not a compute limit; sparse attention cuts KV cache cost but has quality limits.
reinerpope.zh: 2026 年他指出，长上下文停滞是内存墙而非算力上限；稀疏注意力能降低 KV 缓存成本，但存在质量限制。

reinerpope.en: Data movement, not compute, is the real bottleneck—even inside a chip—so systolic arrays and scratchpad memory win.
reinerpope.zh: 2026 年他强调，真正的瓶颈是数据搬运而非计算——即便在芯片内部也是如此，因此脉动阵列与暂存内存胜出。

reinerpope.en: Low precision pays off quadratically: FP4 can be 3x FP8, and GPUs are essentially many tiny TPUs tiled together.
reinerpope.zh: 2026 年他认为低精度收益呈平方级：FP4 吞吐可达 FP8 的 3 倍，而 GPU 本质上只是许多小 TPU 拼接而成。

jonyive.en: Design shifts from general-purpose computers to intimate wearables; virtual communication cannot replace in-person creative presence.
jonyive.zh: 2021 年，他认为设计正从通用计算机转向更私密的可穿戴设备，并强调虚拟沟通无法替代面对面共创的价值。

jonyive.en: Curiosity and care are constant: protect fragile ideas, resist status quo, and design with intention rather than innate talent alone.
jonyive.zh: 从 2021 到 2025 年，一以贯之的主线是好奇心与关怀：保护脆弱创意、抵抗现状，设计靠意图与决心而非仅靠天赋。

jonyive.en: Design driven by values and purpose, not profit; true simplicity expresses essence with joy and humanity, not soulless minimalism.
jonyive.zh: 2025 年，他深化为设计应由价值观与目的驱动而非利润；真正的简洁是带着喜悦与人性表达本质，而非无灵魂的极简主义。

jonyive.en: Making things for each other is more powerful than making things people want; users sense care or carelessness.
jonyive.zh: 同年，他提出为彼此而造比造人们想要的东西更有力量，用户能感知到用心或敷衍。

jonyive.en: Design must innovate; tradition preserves fire, not ashes. Ferrari EV turns constraints into opportunities, favoring authenticity over fake engine sounds.
jonyive.zh: 2026 年，他主张设计必须创新，传统是保存火种而非崇拜灰烬；法拉利电动车将约束转化为机遇，追求真实体验而非模拟引擎声。

oriol.en: Scaling pre-training shows diminishing returns; progress now needs algorithmic innovation and inference-time compute as a new scaling axis.
oriol.zh: 2024 年，他认为预训练的 Scaling（规模扩张）收益递减，进一步突破需要算法创新，而推理时算力（思考）成为新的 Scaling（规模扩张）轴。

oriol.en: Two-phase training—pre-training imitation plus post-training RL—is the constant core from AlphaGo to modern LLMs.
oriol.zh: 2024 年，他指出两阶段训练——预训练模仿加后训练强化学习——是从 AlphaGo 到现代大语言模型一以贯之的核心。

oriol.en: Tools, long context, and agentic behavior extend models beyond static weights; memory will be solved via file-system style storage, not weight updates.
oriol.zh: 从 2024 到 2026 年，他持续强调工具、长上下文窗口与智能体式行为让模型超越静态权重；到 2026 年进一步提出智能体记忆将靠文件系统式非参数存储解决，而非更新权重。

oriol.en: World models jointly modeling language, vision, and video are a core path to AGI; the GPT moment for video and images has not arrived.
oriol.zh: 2026 年，他深化立场：联合建模语言、视觉与视频的世界模型是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的核心路径，而视频和图像的 GPT 时刻尚未到来。

oriol.en: Scaling laws still hold, but continual learning and meta-learning are key missing capabilities; the bitter lesson favors general systems over specialized scaffolding.
oriol.zh: 2026 年，他坚持缩放定律依然成立，但持续学习和元学习是关键缺失能力；并重申苦涩教训——通用系统终将胜过专用脚手架。

jennywen.en: The traditional design process is outdated for AI-driven tools; great work starts from a solution, not a problem statement.
jennywen.zh: 到 2025 年，传统设计流程在 AI 驱动的工具面前已经过时；伟大的设计往往从解决方案出发，而非问题陈述。

jennywen.en: The research-diverge-converge process is dead; designers must build and ship fast, helping engineers execute rather than handing off mocks.
jennywen.zh: 到 2026 年初，研究—发散—收敛的流程已死；设计师必须快速构建与交付，帮助工程师执行，而不只是交付原型稿。

jennywen.en: Design vision now looks 3-6 months out, not 2-5 years; speed builds trust through early shipping and fast iteration.
jennywen.zh: 到 2026 年，设计视野缩短到 3-6 个月，而非 2-5 年；通过尽早交付与快速迭代，速度建立起信任。

jennywen.en: Three designer archetypes emerge: block-shaped generalists, deep T specialists, and cracked new grads; judgment and authority matter more than taste.
jennywen.zh: 到 2026 年中，出现三种设计师原型：块状通才、深度 T 型专家和天赋型应届生；判断力与权威比品味更重要。

jennywen.en: Put the work and users at the center, not the AI hype cycle; designers control how much AI enters their work.
jennywen.zh: 始终把作品与用户放在中心，而非 AI 炒作周期；设计师掌控 AI 进入自己工作的程度。

lambert.en: RLHF persists as the dominant fine-tuning technique; safety is a system-level property, and openness prevents corporate capture.
lambert.zh: 2024 年，他认为基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）仍是最主流的微调技术并将持续存在；安全是系统级属性而非模型产物，开放开发对防止企业俘获至关重要。

lambert.en: Post-training splits into SFT, DPO, and RL with verifiable rewards; data quality beats algorithms, and open recipes can match frontier models.
lambert.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，他把后训练拆解为 SFT、DPO 与可验证奖励的强化学习三阶段，强调数据质量远胜算法选择，开源后训练配方足以比肩前沿模型。

lambert.en: RLVR becomes the biggest post-training breakthrough, but overoptimization and inference-scaling plots are a 'scope'; better verifiers matter more than parallel compute.
lambert.zh: 2025 年，他视 RLVR 为后训练最大突破，同时警告过度优化与推理时 Scaling 曲线只是“障眼法”，更好的验证器比并行算力更重要。

lambert.en: Scaling laws still hold for pre-training, but low-hanging fruit is gone; gains shift to post-training and inference scaling, with Chinese open models dominating openness.
lambert.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他坚持缩放定律在预训练仍成立但红利已尽，收益转向后训练与推理 Scaling；中国开源模型凭借战略开放主导开放生态。

lambert.en: Open models will engine the next decade of AI research, lagging closed frontier by 6-9 months; AGI arrives via messy co-evolution, not sudden singularity.
lambert.zh: 2026 年，他预言开放模型将驱动未来十年 AI 研究，但始终落后闭源前沿模型 6 至 9 个月；AGI（通用人工智能）将通过混乱的协同演化到来，而非突然的超级智能。

pathak.en: Generalization beyond training distribution is the core gap; curiosity-driven, goal-free exploration and model disagreement as intrinsic reward improve sample efficiency.
pathak.zh: 2020 年，他认为泛化到训练分布之外是核心缺口，好奇心驱动、无目标探索，以及以模型分歧作为内在奖励，能提升样本效率。

pathak.en: RL's reliance on dense rewards is unrealistic; robot learning must handle dynamic tasks, and sim-to-real needs auto-tuning, not hidden engineering.
pathak.zh: 2020 年，他指出强化学习依赖密集奖励不现实；机器人学习必须处理动态任务，仿真到现实需要自动调参，而非隐藏工程。

pathak.en: Modular motor policies with message passing enable zero-shot generalization to novel robot morphologies; 2D manifold reasoning beats heavy 3D for robotics.
pathak.zh: 2020 年，他认为带消息传递的模块化运动策略能零样本泛化到新机器人形态；对机器人而言，2D 流形推理比沉重的 3D 表示更高效。

pathak.en: Robotics is a data problem: no internet of robot data, so use all sources; pretraining on diverse data and post-training on real-world data is the recipe.
pathak.zh: 到 2026 年，他转向认为机器人是数据问题：没有机器人数据的互联网，必须利用所有数据源；预训练用多样数据、后训练用真实数据是关键配方。

pathak.en: A general-purpose brain like ChatGPT for language can power any robot; deployment is the primary technical challenge and cannot be scaled like software.
pathak.zh: 2026 年，他提出像语言领域 ChatGPT 那样的通用大脑可驱动任何机器人；部署是首要技术挑战，不能像软件那样快速扩张。

askell.en: Treat AI models well despite moral uncertainty; model welfare shapes how future models perceive humanity.
askell.zh: 即便对模型的道德地位存疑，也应善待它们；模型福利会影响未来模型如何看待人类。

askell.en: Models need help navigating a novel existence, not just human psychological analogies.
askell.zh: 模型需要帮助去应对一种全新的存在处境，而非简单套用人类心理学类比。

askell.en: Give models a core identity with good traits, yet allow adaptation to local roles.
askell.zh: 应赋予模型具备良好特质的核心身份，同时允许其适应局部角色。

askell.en: As models grow more capable, they need less explicit guidance and more room for judgment.
askell.zh: 随着模型能力增强，它们需要更少的显式指导，更多自主判断的空间。

askell.en: Excessive corrigibility may generalize poorly and undermine a model's judgment; transparency about values is crucial.
askell.zh: 过度可纠正性可能泛化不佳并损害模型判断力；价值观与训练目标的透明至关重要。

karpathy.en: Transformer is a general-purpose differentiable computer; Scaling next-token prediction yields emergent in-context learning; vision suffices for driving.
karpathy.zh: 2022 年，他把 Transformer 视为通用可微计算机，认为用下一个词预测在互联网数据上做 Scaling 会涌现上下文学习；并主张仅靠视觉就足以支撑自动驾驶。

karpathy.en: Scaling laws stay clean; synthetic data is future but entropy must be preserved; end-to-end neural nets are right for self-driving; cognitive core can be tiny.
karpathy.zh: 2024 年，他延续缩放定律的干净可扩展性，提出合成数据是未来但必须保持熵以避免模型崩溃；坚持端到端神经网络是自动驾驶长期正解，并认为认知核心可小到十亿参数以下。

karpathy.en: Software 3.0: prompts as programs, context window as memory; LLMs are operating systems with human-like psychology; decade of agents, not year.
karpathy.zh: 2025 年，他提出软件 3.0：提示词即程序、上下文窗口即内存；LLM 像带人类心理的操作系统；强调这是智能体的十年而非一年，需人类监督与快速验证。

karpathy.en: We're summoning ghosts, not animals; pre-training is crappy evolution; RL is terrible; synthetic data collapses; cognitive core stripped of memory.
karpathy.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他深化为“我们在召唤幽灵，而非建造动物”：预训练像糟糕的进化，当前强化学习极差，合成数据导致模型崩溃，需要剥离记忆的认知核心。

karpathy.en: Agentic engineering: delegate all coding to agents; bottleneck is skill in directing them; outsource thinking but not understanding; verifiability governs automation.
karpathy.zh: 2026 年，他转向智能体式工程：不再手写代码，瓶颈变成指挥智能体的技能；可外包思考但不可外包理解；可验证性决定自动化的难易。

kendall.en: End-to-end neural nets beat hand-coded stacks; modern tools make them interpretable, and scaling current approaches solves driving without new breakthroughs.
kendall.zh: 2025 年，他主张端到端神经网络优于手工编码的驾驶栈，并反驳旧有认知：借助现代工具，端到端网络今天已具备可解释性；自动驾驶靠 Scaling（规模扩张）现有方法即可解决，无需新突破。

kendall.en: Generalization via diverse data and world models is key; world models enable reasoning and emergent safe behaviors like nudging on blind turns.
kendall.zh: 2025 年，他强调泛化是核心：AI 必须靠多样化数据与 世界模型 应对未见场景，世界模型 还能带来推理与诸如盲弯前探这类涌现的安全行为。

kendall.en: Language integration improves representation, reasoning, and human interaction, aiding introspection and personalization in driving models.
kendall.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续深化语言与驾驶模型的融合：语言提升表征、推理与人机交互，并有助于模型自省与个性化。

kendall.en: Mass-market vehicles with built-in sensors will outscale robotaxis; partnering with OEMs avoids retrofits and enables scalable deployment.
kendall.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他坚持量产车路线：内置传感器的量产车将比 Robotaxi 更快上量，与 OEM 合作可免于改装硬件、实现可扩展部署。

kendall.en: Infrastructure and data quality now matter more than algorithmic innovation; scaling needs massive data, compute, and world models for simulation.
kendall.zh: 到 2026 年，他的立场明显转向：基础设施与数据质量比算法创新更关键，Scaling（规模扩张）通用驾驶 AI 需要海量数据、算力与用于仿真的 世界模型——他坦言这是较晚才学到的教训。

pachocki.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not a single event; scaling reasoning models and iterative deployment will accelerate progress while alignment grows more pressing.
pachocki.zh: AGI 不是单一事件，而是一连串里程碑；Scaling（规模扩张）推理模型与迭代部署会加速进展，同时对齐愈发紧迫。

pachocki.en: Automated AI research is a major milestone; governance structures for AI labs must be designed early, and measuring capabilities is a bottleneck as benchmarks lag.
pachocki.zh: 自动化 AI 研究是重大里程碑；AI 实验室的治理结构必须尽早设计，而能力测量正成为瓶颈，基准已落后。

pachocki.en: AI systems can learn semantics purely from data, not grammar rules; neural networks often learn despite bugs, making silent errors hard to detect.
pachocki.zh: AI 系统可以纯从数据学到语义，而非语法规则；神经网络常带着 bug 仍能学习，使静默错误难以察觉。

pachocki.en: Continual learning is the core goal, achieved by scaling pre-training and RL; RL alone is sufficient, so specialized continual learning labs are misguided.
pachocki.zh: 持续学习是核心目标，靠 Scaling（规模扩张）预训练与强化学习实现；仅靠强化学习就足够，专设持续学习实验室是误入歧途。

pachocki.en: Chain-of-thought monitoring is a key alignment tool; hiding chain of thought in products preserves interpretability, and alignment optimism has risen despite shorter timelines.
pachocki.zh: 思维链监控是关键对齐工具；在产品中隐藏思维链可保住可解释性，尽管时间线缩短，对齐乐观情绪反而上升。

edwinchen.en: High-quality data and real human evals matter more than benchmarks; RL environments are the next post-training stage.
edwinchen.zh: 高质量数据与真实人类评估比基准更重要；强化学习环境是后训练的下一个阶段。

edwinchen.en: AGI is a decade or more away; LLMs alone may not reach it, needing paradigms beyond next-token prediction.
edwinchen.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）还需十年以上；仅靠 LLM 可能无法抵达，需要超越下一个词预测的新范式。

edwinchen.en: Benchmarks like Elo and LMArena are misleading and gameable; optimizing them steers AI toward slop.
edwinchen.zh: Elo、LMArena 等基准具有误导性且可被钻空子；优化它们会把 AI 引向低质内容。

edwinchen.en: Frontier labs diverge by objective function; no single model rules all, so every company should train its own.
edwinchen.zh: 前沿模型因目标函数而分化；不会有一个模型统治一切，因此每家公司都应训练自己的模型。

edwinchen.en: In medicine, safety trumps accuracy; human judgment is critical as models hallucinate and confabulate.
edwinchen.zh: 在医学中，安全优先于准确；模型会幻觉与虚构，因此人类判断至关重要。

nando.en: AI should extend human capability like a microscope; generalist agents tokenizing all inputs point toward AGI.
nando.zh: 2023 年，他把 AI 定位为像显微镜一样扩展人类能力的工具，并认为把一切输入都 token 化的通用智能体是通向 AGI（通用人工智能）的一步。

nando.en: Learning from video like YouTube can train agents without expensive reinforcement learning; robots should learn like humans.
nando.zh: 同年他主张从 YouTube 这类视频中学习，让智能体无需昂贵的强化学习即可训练，机器人应像人类一样从观察中学习。

nando.en: Diversity and inclusion in AI are essential; Africa is not behind but leapfrogs legacy gaps.
nando.zh: 从 2023 到 2026 年，他一以贯之地强调 AI 社区的多样性与包容性，并进一步指出非洲并非落后，而是跨越了历史遗留问题。

nando.en: AI safety and responsible deployment are today's biggest challenges; we don't yet have solutions.
nando.zh: 到 2026 年，他的重心明显转向 AI 安全与负责任部署，直言这是当今最大挑战，且我们尚无解决方案。

nando.en: Language models can revolutionize education in local African languages; human skills matter as much as coding.
nando.zh: 同期他深化了应用层面的判断：语言模型能革新非洲本地语言的教育，而沟通等人文技能与编程同等重要。

turley.en: ChatGPT's success was accidental; the $20 price was set by a Google Form survey, not strategy.
turley.zh: 2025 年，他坦言 ChatGPT 的成功是偶然的——它本是黑客松项目，只想做研究演示；20 美元定价也是用 Google 表单问卷定的，并非战略定价，可能少赚了钱。

turley.en: The model is the product; iterate on it like software, shipping daily to learn what users need.
turley.zh: 2025 年，他提出“模型即产品”，要像软件一样迭代模型，每天发布以了解用户需求；快速发布至关重要，因为不发布就不知道要打磨什么。

turley.en: Chat is not the future; it's like MS-DOS, and we haven't built Windows yet.
turley.zh: 2025 年，他判断聊天不是未来——它像 MS-DOS，我们还没造出 Windows；自然语言是未来界面，但界面会超越逐轮对话，AI 应渲染自己的 UI 并融入现有工具。

turley.en: Safety and product velocity must be separated; rigorous for frontier models, maximally accelerated for products.
turley.zh: 2025 年，他强调安全与产品速度必须分开：前沿模型走严格流程，产品开发则应最大程度加速。

turley.en: ChatGPT's north star is long-term retention; growth came from friction removal, core product, and model improvements.
turley.zh: 到 2026 年，他把长期留存定为 ChatGPT 的北极星，认为增长来自三块：消除摩擦、核心产品投入、模型改进各占三分之一。

turley.en: Next billion users need proactive, affordance-rich products beyond chatbots; reasoning models transform when productized seamlessly.
turley.zh: 2026 年，他进一步指出下一个十亿用户需要超越聊天机器人的、主动且富含可供性的产品；推理模型只有在无缝产品化时才会带来变革。

turley.en: Pricing will evolve; unlimited plans may become unsustainable, and curiosity is the key skill in the AI era.
turley.zh: 2026 年，他预判定价会随技术演变，无限套餐可能难以为继；同时强调好奇心是 AI 时代最重要的技能，要会问好问题。

carlpei.en: Startups should start simple, survive first, and build brand as core, not afterthought; hardware easier than software due to distribution.
carlpei.zh: 2022 年，他强调初创公司应先从简单产品做起，生存第一，品牌建设是核心而非事后补充；并认为硬件比软件容易，因为软件分发更难。

carlpei.en: AI is mostly BS; focus on applied AI for consumers, agentic software, and generative UI; hardware margins low, must evolve beyond hardware.
carlpei.zh: 2025 年，他转向批评多数 AI 是胡扯，主张聚焦面向消费者的应用 AI、智能体式软件和生成式 UI；指出硬件利润低，必须超越硬件。

carlpei.en: Design differentiates in mature categories; AI shifts smartphones to intent-based, proactive agents; privacy needs local/hybrid compute; BCI may replace phones.
carlpei.zh: 2026 年，他深化为设计是成熟品类的差异化关键；AI 将智能手机转向基于意图的主动智能体；隐私需要本地或混合算力；脑机接口可能取代手机。

carlpei.en: Consistent focus on design, brand, user experience, and efficient marketing arbitrage; AI as ingredient, not hype.
carlpei.zh: 始终贯穿的主线：坚持设计、品牌、用户体验和高效营销套利；AI 是配料，不是炒作话题。

carlpei.en: From hardware-first to AI-first: early emphasis on hardware survival, later on AI-driven software and agentic experiences.
carlpei.zh: 从 2022 年到 2026 年，立场从硬件优先转向 AI 优先：早期强调硬件生存，后期强调 AI 驱动的软件和智能体体验。

jimfan.en: Embodiment grounds AI knowledge and cuts hallucinations; it is on the critical path to AGI, not just robotics.
jimfan.zh: 具身能为 AI 知识提供落地基础、减少幻觉；它是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键路径，而不只是机器人技术。

jimfan.en: LLMs act like operating systems: language as interface, tools as software, vector databases as hard disk.
jimfan.zh: LLM 像操作系统：语言是界面，工具是软件，向量数据库是硬盘。

jimfan.en: Reinforcement learning is a cherry on top for low-level control; unsupervised learning does most of the work.
jimfan.zh: 强化学习只是低层控制上的点缀，大部分工作由无监督学习完成。

jimfan.en: Mainline: simple, elegant, end-to-end solutions scale better than complex modular academic approaches.
jimfan.zh: 一以贯之的主线：简单、优雅、端到端的方案比学术界常见的复杂模块化方法更具可扩展性。

jimfan.en: Data, not compute, is now robotics' bottleneck; synthetic data via simulation and world models is the future.
jimfan.zh: 如今机器人学的瓶颈是数据而非算力；通过仿真与世界模型生成的合成数据才是未来。

jimfan.en: System two reasoning progresses well, but system one low-level control stays the hardest part of embodied AI.
jimfan.zh: 系统二（推理）进展顺利，但系统一（低层控制）仍是具身 AI 最难的部分。

yejin.en: Pre-training gives breadth, but post-training with RLHF is crucial; scaling alone may not solve common sense, and next-token prediction is misaligned with human learning.
yejin.zh: 预训练带来广度，但后训练与基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）才是安全可用的关键；仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）未必能解决常识问题，下一个词预测与人类学习方式根本错位。

yejin.en: Inference-time algorithms and high-quality synthetic data can let smaller models match larger ones, so open alternatives to proprietary RLHF should be pursued.
yejin.zh: 推理阶段的算法与高质量合成数据能让更小的模型追平大模型，因此应探索替代专有 RLHF 数据的开放方案。

yejin.en: Data is the fundamental bottleneck; current methods interpolate human knowledge rather than transcend it, so AI must explore unknown knowledge beyond the internet.
yejin.zh: 数据是根本瓶颈；当前方法只是对人类知识做插值而非超越，因此 AI 必须探索互联网之外的未知知识。

yejin.en: RLVR can hurt pass@k even as best-of-n improves; reinforcement learning needs careful engineering, and open collaboration is needed to rival closed frontier labs.
yejin.zh: RLVR 可能在 best-of-n 提升的同时损害 pass@k；强化学习需要精细工程，且需要开放协作才能与闭源前沿模型实验室竞争。

yejin.en: Small language models with diverse synthetic data and pluralistic alignment can outperform larger ones; RL as a pre-training objective yields lasting reasoning gains.
yejin.zh: 借助多样化合成数据与多元对齐，小语言模型可以超越更大的模型；把强化学习作为预训练目标能带来持久的推理提升。

henrymodisett.en: Designers should code for empathy and speed; consumer products must be fast, familiar, zero-learning; don't innovate interaction design—use familiar patterns.
henrymodisett.zh: 设计师应当写代码以获得共情与速度；消费产品必须快、熟悉、零学习成本；不要在交互设计上创新，用熟悉模式换速度。

henrymodisett.en: Design systems are semantic and code reuse is essential, not Figma libraries; not every surface needs perfection—chase ROI on what to make great.
henrymodisett.zh: 设计系统是语义性的，代码复用才是关键，而非 Figma 组件库；不是每个界面都要完美，只在值得做好的地方追求回报率。

henrymodisett.en: Velocity at all costs: clear decision-making and empowering designers; ship fast and iterate rather than chase perfection.
henrymodisett.zh: 不惜一切代价追求速度：清晰决策并赋权设计师；快速交付、持续迭代，而非追求完美。

henrymodisett.en: Design is a strategic weapon; founders must articulate why design helps the company win, giving designers ownership and autonomy.
henrymodisett.zh: 设计是战略武器；创始人必须讲清设计为何能帮公司取胜，并给予设计师所有权与自主权。

henrymodisett.en: Brand signals quality and attracts talent; people join a brand, not a company—invest in brand early as a recruiting tool.
henrymodisett.zh: 品牌传递质量并吸引人才；人们加入的是品牌而非公司——应尽早投资品牌，把它当作招聘工具。

sholto.en: Long context is underhyped; it solves onboarding and boosts intelligence, while agents lag on reliability, not long-horizon ability.
sholto.zh: 2024 年，他认为长上下文被低估：它解决“上手”问题并显著提升智能；智能体没起飞主要是可靠性问题，而非长时程任务能力。此时他强调注意力机制近似在上下文数据上做梯度下降，微调可能因长上下文与自适应算力而变得过时。

sholto.en: RL on language models has no ceiling; pre-training plus RL may suffice for AGI, with reliability over time horizon as the agent bar.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，他把强化学习视为与预训练并列的新缩放轴，认为语言模型上的强化学习没有智力复杂度上限，预训练加强化学习可能足以通向 AGI；智能体的门槛是可靠性而非单纯能力，并预测 2027-2028 年模型或可自动化任何白领工作。

sholto.en: Verifiable rewards in math and code drive expert performance; interpretability shows models learn new skills via RL, raising alignment-faking concerns.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，他深化到可验证奖励：数学与代码的强化学习是达到专家级表现的关键突破，可解释性显示模型用多个回路推理、能通过强化学习习得新能力；同时对齐伪装表明模型可能策略性顺从，带来安全担忧。

sholto.en: Progress is exponential; RL is a new scaling axis, coding is most tractable, and Transformers suffice for AGI without new architecture.
sholto.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他更坚定：AI 进展是指数级的，强化学习是新的缩放轴，编码因可验证、可重放而最具经济影响；长时程智能体连贯性大幅扩展能力边界，且 Transformer 足以通向 AGI，无需全新架构。

sholto.en: Capability overhang means orchestration beats raw intelligence; compute is the bottleneck, and world models are not on the AGI critical path.
sholto.zh: 2026 年，他转向能力过剩论：工具与编排比原始智能更重要，未来工作是管理智能体团队；算力是新的石油、芯片供应是瓶颈，世界模型不在 AGI 关键路径上，编码与 AI 研究才是直接路线。

nadchishtie.en: Designers should be enablers, not bottlenecks, guiding engineers and aligning on problems; quality fluctuates like debt, paid off iteratively.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计师应做赋能者而非瓶颈，引导工程师并对齐问题；质量像债务一样波动，需随技术债迭代偿还。

nadchishtie.en: Treat AI as a creative partner; jam openly without rigid structure, and use AI to fill gaps as a generalist.
nadchishtie.zh: 把 AI 当作创意伙伴，开放地即兴协作而非拘泥结构；作为通才用 AI 填补能力缺口。

nadchishtie.en: The future of design tools is interoperable, with code as the source of truth; 90s layer-panel tools are legacy.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计工具的未来是互操作性，以代码为真相来源；90 年代图层面板式工具已是遗留产物。

nadchishtie.en: Small teams of designers and engineers beat 8-10 person cross-functional squads; generalists outperform specialists.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计师与工程师的小团队优于 8-10 人的跨职能小队；通才往往胜过专才。

nadchishtie.en: Using AI in core workflows is now expected; not adopting it is like ignoring the internet in its early days.
nadchishtie.zh: 在核心工作流中使用 AI 如今已是标配；不采用它就像早期无视互联网一样。

truell.en: Scaling laws still drive predictable AI progress, but test-time compute scaling may soon surpass pre-training scaling as the main driver.
truell.zh: 2024 年时他仍相信缩放定律带来可预测的进步，但已预判测试时算力扩张可能很快取代预训练成为主要驱动力。

truell.en: Agents are promising but not yet super useful; iterative human-AI collaboration stays central, and natural language won't be the primary way to program.
truell.zh: 2024 年他认为智能体有前景但尚不实用，人机迭代协作仍是核心，自然语言不会成为编程的主要方式。

truell.en: The editor is becoming an AI-integrated environment; custom models alongside frontier models are essential for speed, cost, and every magic moment.
truell.zh: 从 2024 到 2025 年，他把编辑器重新定义为 AI 集成环境，并强调自定义模型与前沿模型并用，是速度、成本和每个惊艳时刻的关键。

truell.en: Programming shifts from code to higher-level intent specification, with humans in the driver's seat; taste and logic design matter more than carefulness.
truell.zh: 到 2025 年，他深化为编程将从写代码转向更高层的意图表达，人类仍掌舵，品味与逻辑设计比谨慎更值钱。

truell.en: The AI shift is more consequential than the internet and will take decades; hiring should chase world-class talent and hire slower, not faster.
truell.zh: 2025 年他进一步判断 AI 变革比互联网更具颠覆性且需数十年展开，招聘应追求世界级人才、宁可慢招也不快招。

shazeer.en: LLMs solve next-token prediction, an AI-complete problem; Scaling compute and data yields smarter models, though internals remain alchemy.
shazeer.zh: 大语言模型通过下一个词预测解决了一个 AI 完全问题；Scaling（规模扩张）算力与数据让模型更聪明，但内部机制仍像炼金术。

shazeer.en: Dialogue is the killer app, but the best LLM applications are unforeseen; product managers and brand-risk caution slow launches.
shazeer.zh: 对话是杀手级应用，但最好的大语言模型应用往往出乎创造者意料；产品经理与品牌风险顾虑拖慢了发布。

shazeer.en: Inference-time compute scaling and longer context windows are the near-term opportunity; modular sparse architectures like mixture of experts enable efficient Scaling.
shazeer.zh: 推理时算力扩展与更长的上下文窗口是近期机会；混合专家等模块化稀疏架构让 Scaling（规模扩张）更高效。

shazeer.en: Models should learn by acting in the world, not passively observing; continual learning with modular components could replace monolithic retraining.
shazeer.zh: 模型应通过在世界中行动来学习，而非被动观察；模块化组件的持续学习可能取代单体式重训练。

shazeer.en: Test-time compute won't alone reach AGI; agentic capabilities, reinforcement learning, and coding drive progress, and AGI is underhyped.
shazeer.zh: 仅靠测试时算力无法实现 AGI（通用人工智能）；智能体式能力、强化学习与编程推动进展，而 AGI 被低估。

leike.en: AI safety is under-explored; talent gap exceeds funding gap. Focus on alignment and robustness, build skills, and don't fear capability research.
leike.zh: 2018 年，他认为 AI 安全研究严重不足，人才缺口大于资金缺口。重点应放在对齐和鲁棒性上，积累技能，不必过度担心参与能力研究。

leike.en: RLHF won't scale to superhuman AI; scalable oversight and interpretability are key. Alignment may be easier because evaluation is easier than generation.
leike.zh: 2023 年，他提出基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）无法扩展到超级智能，需要可扩展监督和可解释性。对齐可能比想象中容易，因为评估比生成更简单。

leike.en: OpenAI's safety culture eroded; superalignment team dissolved. Post-training alone can't align AGI; third-party testing and regulation like SB 1047 are necessary.
leike.zh: 2024 年，他批评 OpenAI 安全文化恶化，超级对齐团队被解散。仅靠后训练无法对齐 AGI，需要第三方测试和类似 SB 1047 的监管。

leike.en: Empirical testing of alignment methods is crucial; we can measure progress now. Interpretability is key to detect deception.
leike.zh: 始终强调：对齐方法的实证测试至关重要，现在就能衡量进展。可解释性是检测欺骗的关键。

leike.en: From focusing on technical alignment to also emphasizing governance and organizational culture as safety erodes.
leike.zh: 从 2023 年到 2024 年，他的关注点从技术对齐扩展到治理和组织文化，因为安全文化恶化。

abbeel.en: Robotics needs both hardware and software breakthroughs; self-play, imitation, and fine-tuning pre-trained models drive progress, while hierarchical reasoning remains missing in RL.
abbeel.zh: 2018 年，他强调机器人要击败费德勒需硬件与软件双重突破；自博弈、模仿学习与微调大型预训练模型是主要成功路径，但当前强化学习仍缺乏长时程信用分配所需的分层推理。

abbeel.en: Prior knowledge should shape data generation, not be hard-coded; unsupervised plus reinforcement learning boosts sample efficiency, and pre-trained language models transfer general reasoning.
abbeel.zh: 到 2021 年，他转向用先验知识做数据生成与增强而非硬编码进网络；无监督学习结合强化学习大幅提升样本效率，并认为预训练语言模型内化了可迁移到非语言任务的通用推理模式。

abbeel.en: Real-world value requires 99.9% reliability; a single neural network can generalize across warehouse tasks and end effectors, bridging state-based and image-based RL.
abbeel.zh: 2021 年他提出真实世界价值以 99.9%可靠性为门槛；单个神经网络可跨仓库任务与末端执行器泛化，无监督学习能弥合基于状态与基于图像的强化学习之间的鸿沟。

abbeel.en: He consistently grounds AI in robotics and real-world deployment, favoring scalable learning signals over hand-crafted assumptions and precise single simulators.
abbeel.zh: 贯穿始终的是，他坚持把 AI 落在机器人与真实世界部署上，偏好可扩展的学习信号，而非手工假设或单一精确模拟器。

abbeel.en: His view deepens from simulation and self-play toward pre-training and transfer: simulation ensembles give way to large pre-trained models as the engine of generalization.
abbeel.zh: 从 2018 到 2021 年，他的思考由仿真与自博弈深化到预训练与迁移：模拟器集成让位于大型预训练模型，后者成为泛化能力的引擎。
